ranked.name: Quiet Accumulation (Flow-Price Divergence)
ranked.data_source: investor_flow (Foreign+Institutional NetBuy KRW) + rawdata (Ret,Vol,Size); cross-sectional expanding-beta residual of flow_z on price_resp_z
ranked.rationale: Best-specified of the four duplicate flow-vs-price divergence concepts (M39 / microstructure FPD / this). Picked as canonical because it uses an expanding cross-sectional no-intercept beta with 60m burn-in mirroring the proven INV13 accumulator — a real PIT-clean residualization, not a naive z-difference. Mechanism is causal and clean: informed accumulation under flat tape = inelastic demand not yet priced (Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang lineage). Orthogonality_potential=5: half the signal is non-return flow and the price leg is SUBTRACTED, so by construction anti-correlated with M01 — directly attacks the spanning concern. Feasibility 4: foreign NetBuy 89.9% populated, T+1 lag enforced. Novelty only 3 (idea is published; KR long-only construction is the fresh part) — honest. Top Tier A.

ranked.name: C21_Flow_Confirmed_Revision
ranked.data_source: consensus (eps_chg_1m/esbr) x investor flow (inst+foreign NetBuy 20d z)
ranked.rationale: Strongest single candidate. Interaction of analyst up-revision with smart-money flow confirmation — combines TWO non-return information sets (consensus + flow), neither of which any M* factor touches. Mechanism is the cleanest causal story in the set: a revision informed investors are NOT buying is stale/priced; one they ARE buying carries incremental info (revision-drift arbitraged faster when flow present). Orthogonality_potential=5: zero existing factor combines flow with consensus, and the PRODUCT captures conditional info that linear combos of the two marginals miss. Feasibility 4: both legs cached, daily flow disclosure clean. Honest risk flagged by the proposer: flow and revision may be mildly correlated (both react to same news) so incremental power must be MEASURED — but even if the interaction proves med, the marginals are each non-return and orthogonal to the M-cluster. Highest total.

ranked.name: M36_SignedFlowRun (Investor-Flow Directional Run-Length Momentum)
ranked.data_source: QuantiWise Foreign+Institutional daily NetBuy; consecutive same-sign run-length, T+1 lag
ranked.rationale: Despite the return_math label this is NOT return-derived — built purely on investor flow identity. Mechanism is sound: a sustained one-directional informed streak proxies a multi-day execution program not completable in one day (market impact), predicting continued same-direction pressure. Orthogonality_potential=5 vs M01/M08/M24 (different info set). Genuinely distinct from INV09_Flow_Persistence which is a SIGN-COUNT fraction (sign-blind to consecutiveness): 10 alternating days = persistence 0.5 / run-length ~1; this is the real differentiator. Novelty 3 (natural refinement of INV09, must test correlation with it). Feasibility 4. Tier A as a non-return flow concept with high orthogonality.

ranked.name: Strategic-Corporate (OtherCorp) Accumulation
ranked.data_source: investor_flow OtherCorp (기타법인) daily NetBuy, 40d frollsum/Size + persistence, 49% sparsity floor
ranked.rationale: Most distinctively-KR concept in the set and the only one tapping a completely unused data channel — OtherCorp is consumed by ZERO existing INV factor (INV01-13 use only Foreign/Inst/Individual). Mechanism: chaebol affiliate cross-holdings, treasury-share buybacks, control consolidation = insider-adjacent conviction (buyback anomaly lineage). Orthogonality_potential=5 by construction (untapped agent channel, non-return). kr_fit=5 (chaebol/holdco/자사주 structures are central KR microstructure). Feasibility dropped to 3: 49% sparsity means many small/mid names route to NA, reducing breadth — proposer flagged honestly. Strong Tier A on novelty+orthogonality despite the breadth limitation.

ranked.name: Investor-Flow Co-Movement Network Momentum (FlowNet)
ranked.data_source: flow_features_daily (inst/foreign netbuy 5/20/60d); flow-affinity graph clustering, neighbor flow momentum lagged
ranked.rationale: Cluster stocks by similarity of investor-flow TIME SERIES (not price), signal = flow-neighbors' net-buying momentum not yet in own price. Built entirely from non-return flow volumes — orthogonality_potential=5 by data axis. Mechanism: coordinated institutional basket reallocation propagates across a flow-cluster gradually (capacity staging). Novelty 4 (no flow-network factor exists in infra; flow features only used as per-stock scalars). kr_fit=5 (foreign/inst basket/program trades dominate KOSPI200). Feasibility 3, honestly flagged: flow_features_daily may lack the raw per-stock investor series needed for similarity clustering at full history — likely requires rebuilding network input from investor_stock cache, and pre-2010 foreign coverage sparse. Tier A but with a real build-cost caveat.

ranked.name: Smart-Money Lead / Retail-Lag Sequencing
ranked.data_source: investor_flow Foreign+Inst vs Individual; 40d window early/late split or per-stock lead-lag cross-correlation
ranked.rationale: Temporal SEQUENCING between investor cohorts (smart leads, retail follows mid-diffusion) — a genuinely new object vs INV08 (contemporaneous same-window agreement) and INV12 (contemporaneous net). Non-return, orthogonality_potential=5. Mechanism well-grounded in KR (Choe-Kho-Stulz foreign edge, highest retail share in DM). Novelty 4 (Granger-style cohort lead-lag not in zoo). Feasibility 3, honestly flagged: per-stock lead-lag estimates are noisy over short windows, needs 40-60d window + shrinkage, lowering signal-to-noise. Must check correlation with INV07/INV08. Tier A on the non-return + high-orthogonality priority, with estimation-noise as the gating risk.

ranked.name: Liquidity Improvement Momentum (Amihud trend, not level)
ranked.data_source: rawdata Ret/Vol/Close; Amihud on 20d, negative slope of log-Amihud over 126d
ranked.rationale: Non-return signal (price-impact trend) — M01/M08/M24 carry zero liquidity info, so orthogonality_potential=5. Mechanism: improving liquidity attracts liquidity-gated institutional/foreign/pension capital and front-runs index/ETF inclusion — economically real and slow-moving in KR. Feasibility=5: pure OHLCV, trivially PIT-clean, no flow data dependency. Distinct from L10/L29 (2-point Amihud ratios) via regression-slope estimation + improvement-direction framing — but novelty only 3 since it's adjacent to existing illiquidity factors and must be measured against them. Highest-feasibility Tier A: cheap to test, non-return, high orthogonality.

ranked.name: M35_PermEntropyTrend (Permutation-Entropy-Filtered Trend Momentum)
ranked.data_source: OHLC Ret 120d sequence; Bandt-Pompe ordinal permutation entropy (m=4) as momentum-quality scaler
ranked.rationale: Return-derived (priority penalty), but EXPLICITLY differentiated from the failed Hurst (self-similarity scaling exponent) and FIP (up/down sign-count asymmetry): permutation entropy is an ordinal-pattern complexity primitive, a distinct information-theoretic object — the proposer addressed the failure-mode test directly and credibly. Used as a momentum-QUALITY scaler it is orthogonal to vol-adjusted momentum (M13/M14) by construction (entropy is scale-invariant, 0th-order). BUT: orthogonality_potential capped at 3 because the base signal is still sign(126d trend) = return momentum; the entropy is only a multiplicative filter, so the long side will load heavily on M01. Mechanism 3 (orderly-trend-persists story is plausible but the entropy-to-future-return link is more conjectural than the flow concepts). Tier B: worth a residual-IC test against M01, not a headline.

ranked.name: M33_OvernightMom_IntradayReversal / Overnight Return Momentum
ranked.data_source: rawdata Open/Close; accumulate overnight leg ln(Open_t/Close_{t-1}) over 60-126d, skip last day
ranked.rationale: DEDUP NOTE: M33 (return_math) and 'Overnight Return Momentum' (microstructure) are the SAME mechanism — merged here, kept the union. Return-derived, but mechanism is strong: overnight leg aggregates informed/foreign repricing concentrated at the single 09:00 call auction (Lou-Polk-Skouras, Bogousslavsky), persistent, vs mean-reverting intraday retail noise. Orthogonality_potential=4 (higher than typical return-derived): overnight and intraday legs have OPPOSITE sign-autocorrelation, so overnight-only accumulation is a different linear combination of prices than any total-return cumulant (M01 cannot see the split). KR single-auction microstructure genuinely sharpens the split (kr_fit 4). Distinct from L39_Overnight_Spread (single-day NEGATED gap LEVEL). Novelty 3 (US-published, KR application is the new part). Feasibility 4: clean Open prints on K200 large caps, watch bid-ask bounce on KOSDAQ (skip-last-day handles it). Strongest of the return-derived group — top of Tier B.

ranked.name: Flow Steadiness (Drip vs Block Concentration)
ranked.data_source: investor_flow Foreign+Inst daily NetBuy; 20d net flow / HHI(|daily flow|), signed
ranked.rationale: Non-return, second-moment (dispersion) property of the flow series that every existing INV factor — which uses only the SUM/frollsum — is blind to. Mechanism: same 20d total delivered as steady drip = sustained conviction; as one block = one-off rebalance/index event with no forward signal. Orthogonality_potential=4 (flow space, distinct statistic). Honest novelty cap at 3: closest cousin INV09 is a sign-count not a magnitude-dispersion measure, but partial correlation with INV09 is a real risk the proposer flagged — must test. Feasibility 4 (pure within-window aggregation, no expanding beta). Tier B — solid but needs the INV09 incremental check; ranked below the divergence/sequencing flow concepts which have higher orthogonality.

ranked.name: M37_DrawdownRecoverySpeed (Drawdown-Recovery Path Asymmetry)
ranked.data_source: OHLC Close; running peak/drawdown segmentation, recovery-time/drawdown-time ratio over completed 252d episodes
ranked.rationale: Return-derived but a genuinely orthogonal AXIS: time-geometry (time-down vs time-up) not magnitude. Two stocks with identical total return, MaxDD depth, and 52w-high ratio can have opposite recovery-speed signs — so orthogonality_potential=4 despite being price-derived (it is invariant to the levels M01/M06/M17/MaxDD measure). Novelty 4 (recovery-SPEED asymmetry is not a standard cross-sectional equity factor). Mechanism 3: demand-resilience-persists story is plausible but indirect. FEASIBILITY=2 is the binding constraint: episode segmentation (peak-trough-recovery) is fiddly, sparse (few completed episodes per 252d for many names), parameter-sensitive (threshold for what counts as an episode), and the current-incomplete-episode exclusion must be airtight for PIT. Tier B — interesting orthogonal axis but high implementation/estimation risk.

ranked.name: M38_SkewnessMomentum (Change-in-Realized-Skewness)
ranked.data_source: OHLC Ret; 63d realized skewness now minus 63d earlier (change)
ranked.rationale: Return-derived but moment-order orthogonal: 3rd standardized moment CHANGE, independent by construction from mean/vol functions (M01/M13/M14) and from M22_MAX (single extreme-order-statistic level, not distributional). Orthogonality_potential=4. Mechanism 3: 'declining left-skew = fading crash risk repriced with lag' is plausible (Bali-Murray skew pricing) but the CHANGE-as-momentum framing and the sign direction are uncertain — proposer admits direction must be set by KR test, which weakens the ex-ante causal claim. Novelty 3 (static skew is known; temporal change is the twist). Feasibility 3: realized skewness from daily returns is noisy at 63d, the difference-of-two-noisy-estimates amplifies noise. Tier B — orthogonal moment axis but mechanism/direction underdetermined.

ranked.name: M34_RankVelocity (Cross-Sectional Rank Trajectory Velocity)
ranked.data_source: OHLC Ret 126d -> monthly cross-sectional percentile rank -> slope over 3 anchors
ranked.rationale: Return-derived. Slope of the cross-sectional RANK path (rank-climbing velocity) — distinct from M23_Acceleration (2nd derivative of return LEVEL, rank-free). Mechanism 3: relative-strength-improvement attracts benchmark/passive flows in index-aware KR — plausible but a stock can have high M01 yet flat rank-velocity. Orthogonality_potential capped at 3: rank is a monotone transform of the same 126d return that M01 uses, so high empirical correlation with M01 is likely; the time-derivative helps but does not fully break the dependence. Feasibility 4 (fixed-cardinality K200∪KQ150 makes ranks well-defined, easy to compute). Novelty 3. Tier B — needs a residual-IC test vs M01; weakest-orthogonality of the kept return-derived set but cheap to check.

ranked.name: Directed Lead-Lag Momentum Spillover (LLMS)
ranked.data_source: rawdata Close/Ret; 252d directed cross-correlation graph at lag 1-5d, IN-neighbor return pull
ranked.rationale: Return-derived (uses OTHER firms' lagged returns). Distinct from PCDM (failed) because DIRECTION (who-leads-whom) is the signal, not symmetric peer-residual co-movement — proposer addressed the failure mode. Novelty 4 (firm-level estimated directed graph, not size buckets). BUT feasibility=2: edge estimation across ~3900 names is severely noisy, needs heavy shrinkage / top-k pruning, and the lead-lag edges are notoriously unstable out-of-sample. Orthogonality_potential 3: the predictive content is still a function of returns (neighbors'), so spanning by the broader momentum complex is a live risk. Tier C — high novelty but the estimation fragility + return-derived nature put it well below the flow concepts. Test only after the Tier A/B flow ideas.

ranked.name: Sector-Graph Momentum Diffusion (SectorDiff)
ranked.data_source: rawdata Sector/Sector_Lv2/Ret; inter-sector lead matrix, upstream lagged momentum diffusion
ranked.rationale: Return-derived, and the proposer's OWN honest assessment is the verdict: with only 27 sectors the graph is coarse and 'may partially overlap M07' (industry momentum), so orthogonality_potential=2. Menzly-Ozbas inter-industry lead-lag is the anchor — novelty 2 (reasonable extension, not new). kr_fit 4 (KR export/manufacturing vertical chains are real: 반도체→디스플레이, 철강→조선). Mechanism 3. Feasibility 3 (lead-matrix overfitting risk, needs sign-stable-edge shrinkage). Tier C: most likely to be partially spanned by existing M07/M24 sector momentum; lowest-priority of the network concepts on orthogonality grounds.

ranked.name: M-FlowImpliedInelasticity (Absorbed-Supply Kyle-lambda)
ranked.data_source: investor_flow Foreign+Inst + rawdata Ret/Vol/Size; 60d per-stock regression Ret~flow -> lambda, signal = 1/lambda for net-buyers
ranked.rationale: Proposer EXPLICITLY flags this as the weakest of its group and self-recommends dropping unless it survives an orthogonality check — I concur and keep it at the bottom of the kept set. is_return_derived=true (regresses Ret on flow), so orthogonality_potential=2 vs the M-trio (touches returns directly). Kyle's lambda is classic (Kyle 1985 / Amihud) — novelty 3 only via the flow-conditional KR framing. FEASIBILITY=2: per-stock lambda estimation is noisy and unstable for illiquid names, needs winsorization + obs floors + shrinkage. Mechanism 3 (absorbed-supply story plausible but the 1/lambda inversion amplifies estimation error). Tier C — include ONLY if it clears a hard residual-IC gate vs M01/M08/M24 and the FIP/Hurst/PCDM failure modes; otherwise drop, per the proposer's own honest recommendation.

specs.name: Quiet Accumulation (Flow-Price Divergence)
specs.construction:
신호 정의 (월말 sig_date 횡단면, 종목 i):

QA_t(i) = z_flow_t(i) − beta_t · z_priceresp_t(i)
  여기서 beta_t = expanding no-intercept OLS, LAGGED (sig_date 직전까지 누적상태) — INV13 accumulator 패턴 그대로.

레그 정의 (둘 다 t-1 lag, lookback 윈도 LB 영업일 = 그리드):
1) flow leg (비-수익 절반):
   netbuy_t(i) = frollsum(Foreign + Institutional, LB)  [smart-money 합산 순매수, KRW]
   flow_raw_t(i) = netbuy_t(i) / Size_t-1(i)   ← Size 정규화 (시총 대비 순매수 강도)
   z_flow_t(i) = 횡단면 z-score(winsor 1/99) of flow_raw  [C13 Z_Score_Aligned]

2) price-response leg (SUBTRACTED — 직교성의 핵심):
   priceresp_raw_t(i) = sum_{d in LB} Ret_d(i)   ← LB창 누적 단순수익(=가격이 이미 얼마나 반응했나)
   z_priceresp_t(i) = 횡단면 z-score(winsor 1/99) of priceresp_raw

3) residual = 매집강도에서 '이미 가격에 반영된 부분' 제거 → 미반영 inelastic demand 잔차.
   beta_t·z_priceresp 를 빼므로 가격이 이미 오른 종목은 점수 깎임 → M01(price momentum)과 구조적 anti-corr.

방향성: QA 高 = "조용한 매집"(flow 강·price-response 약) = LONG. long-only top-N EW 월간 리밸. canonical_screen_bt 경유 실측.
specs.estimator: no-intercept(원점) expanding OLS, INV13 accumulator 재사용(compute_investor.R L290-426): beta_t=SxY_cum/Sxx_cum, SxY=Σ(z_flow·z_priceresp) Sxx=Σ(z_priceresp²) 월별 횡단면합 누적. LAGGED 사용(직전 달까지 누적 beta만으로 현재 잔차 계산 후 사후 갱신). burn-in 60m(미달 NA). 매 sig_date winsor 1/99→자체 mean/sd z-score(full-sample 금지). score=raw residual(top-N rank 기반이라 추가 z화 불필요). R data.table frollsum + arrow(set_io_thread_count(2)).
specs.lookback_grid: 1차 6 cell: LB∈{21d,42d,63d} × flow∈{Foreign+Institutional 합산, Foreign 단독}, top_n=20 고정. 근거: INV13 검증 21/63/126 중 매집은 단기~중기 핵심 → 21/42/63 우선; Foreign(0.899)>Inst(0.668) 커버리지라 F단독 A/B. 확장(1차 PASS 시): LB=126d + top_n{15,25} sensitivity + burn-in{48,72}m robustness. 6-cell enumerate→argmax이면 essence_score selection_type='sweep'(DSR 게이트 적용), 단일 best 가설보고는 'chain'. 1차는 보수적 'sweep' 분류 권장.
specs.data_inputs: 1) investor_wide.parquet(.cache/investor_stock/): Date,Ticker,Foreign,Institutional,Individual,OtherCorp (일간 순매수 KRW). 실측 범위 2000-01~2026-03, 3410 ticker, Foreign nonzero 0.899/Inst 0.668. 로더 load_investor_stock('wide'). 2) rawdata(.cache/rawdata.parquet): Ret(price-response), Size(정규화 분모 t-1), Vol·Close(ADV 유동성), K200/KQ150(유니버스 0/1/NA, union 실측 348), AdminStock/TradingHalt(제외), Sector. 3) bench_dt: ⚠rawdata BM_Ret 2025+ 2.1%만 채워짐 — 사용금지, canonical BM 로더 별도 조달. 4) returns_dt: rawdata Ret 월간집계 forward 1M Ret_1m PIT-aligned. DART/FRED/ECOS/컨센서스 미사용(flow+price로 완결).
specs.pit_notes: C1: beta는 expanding no-intercept OLS의 LAGGED 누적상태만(직전 달까지), 횡단면 z는 매 sig_date 자체 mean/sd만(전기간 통계 0건), burn-in 60m. C2: investor Date<sig_date strict, Size t-1 최신, price Ret도 sig_date 이전 LB창만. C3: 레그 산출기간≠forward 적용기간. C4: 재무 미사용. C5: 입력 전부 t-1. C6: rawdata PIT 패널 + 시점 K200/KQ150 멤버십(alpha-research 패널검증 의무). C7: 월별 단방향 누적, lookahead_detector PASS 의무. C10: ADV=20d평균(Vol×Close) t-1, liq_min 2e8. C13: Z_Score_Aligned, residual 빼기는 정의된 직교화이지 NEGATE 아님. C14: 모든 Date<sig_date. C15: Factor DB 팩터 미사용(investor/rawdata .cache 직접 load 허용); 직교 비교 시 M01 등은 load_month_factors() 경유. no-full-sample 누출 0.
specs.orthogonality_targets: active-basis(−BM, gross 아님) 상관으로 입증: ①M01/12-1 momentum 최우선(price leg SUBTRACT → 구조적 anti-corr 기대, 목표 |corr|≤0.30, 음상관 허용=메커니즘 증거, spanning 우려 직격) ②INV01/INV02 raw Foreign flow(목표 |corr|≤0.55, 초과 시 price제거 무의미) ③INV13 Foreign_Resid_Individual(동일 accumulator 다른 X레그, |corr|≤0.50) ④STR_1715 book sleeve(admission book-marginal |corr|<0.30 ∧ ΔIR≥0.05) ⑤Size/Low-vol(매집 소형주편향 배제, |corr|≤0.40). 검증: 각 cell residual을 월별 IC/top-N active-return 시계열로 만들어 상관(_ortho_audit active basis 패턴).
build_steps: 1. 데이터 로드: investor_wide.parquet(load_investor_stock 'wide') + rawdata(arrow open_dataset, K200/KQ150/Ret/Size/Vol/Close/AdminStock/TradingHalt, set_io_thread_count(2)로 HANG 회피). 유니버스 = (K200==1|KQ150==1) ∧ !AdminStock ∧ !TradingHalt, 각 sig_date 시점 멤버십.
2. flow leg: 종목별 frollsum(Foreign+Institutional, LB, na.rm, align=right) at t-1 / Size_t-1 → flow_raw. (그리드 flow=F단독이면 Foreign만).
3. price-response leg: 종목별 frollsum(Ret, LB, align=right) at sig_date 이전 → priceresp_raw.
4. 월말 sig_date 횡단면 스냅샷: 종목별 마지막 t-1 값 추출(compute_investor latest=.SD[.N] 패턴). 최소관측 LB×0.75 미달 종목 drop.
5. 횡단면 winsorize 1/99 → z-score(자체 mean/sd) → z_flow, z_priceresp.

6. expanding accumulator: 월별 루프, SxY+=Σ(z_flow·z_priceresp), Sxx+=Σ(z_priceresp²). beta_lagged = (n_months≥60 & 직전 Sxx>1e-10) ? 직전SxY/직전Sxx : NA. residual = z_flow − beta_lagged·z_priceresp. 그 후 accumulator 갱신(LAGGED 보장).
7. scores_dt 빌드: data.table(Date=sig_date, Ticker, score=residual), burn-in NA 행 제거.
8. returns_dt 빌드: rawdata Ret 월간집계 → forward 1M Ret_1m (sig_date PIT-aligned).
9. bench_dt: canonical BM 로더에서 조달(⚠ rawdata BM_Ret 결측 — 사용 금지).
10. liq_dt: ADV=frollmean(Vol×Close,20) at t-1.

11. 실측: source('02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R'); canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8). metric_type='canonical_screen'.
12. 6 cell(LB×flow) 각각 반복 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 / net_sr / IR / turnover_annual 수집.
13. 직교 검증: 각 cell residual 시계열 vs M01/INV01/INV13/Size active-basis(−BM) 상관 산출, orthogonality_targets 대조.
14. 게이트: graduation HARD 3종(PORT_t≥2.95, oos_retention≥0.7[v2 3분할 중앙값], calmar≥0.64) + screening tier(SR≥0.7∧CAGR≥12% or score≥40∧SR≥0.5). sweep 6-cell이면 DSR 게이트 적용.
15. R 안정성: 백테 전 taskkill 잔류 Rscript, 단일스레드 주의(memory r-segfault), arrow read는 set_io_thread_count(2) — 1은 HANG.
specs.honest_risks:
실패 가능 메커니즘 (정직 보고):
1) ★price-residualization이 신호 자체를 죽임: M01과 anti-corr이 목표지만, KR long-only는 시장β≈0.99 바닥 공유(memory §6) — price leg를 빼면 잔차가 시장성분도 일부 제거해 active alpha가 사라질 수 있음. INV13 자체가 graduation 미통과(16/16 PORT_t FAIL 코호트) — "직교 ≠ 수익" 원칙(measurement-graduation §6). orthogonality_potential=5지만 직교가 PORT_t를 보장 안 함.
2) flow-price 동시성 해석 오류: 같은 LB창에서 flow와 price를 둘 다 측정 → "조용한 매집"(high flow, low price)이 사실은 *유동성 공급/장기 분산매도 흡수*일 수 있고 미래 수익과 무관할 수 있음. Llorente 등 lineage는 정보거래 가정인데 KR 외국인/기관 순매수가 항상 informed은 아님(패시브 리밸·인덱스 플로우 혼입).
3) 추정노이즈 — beta 불안정: no-intercept expanding beta는 초기 누적(60~80m)에서 SxY/Sxx 비율이 횡단면 표본수·winsor에 민감. burn-in 직후 잔차 noisy → 2010~2012 구간 OOS 불안정 가능. burn-in {48,72} robustness 필수.
4) 커버리지 편향: Foreign nonzero 0.899이나 소형주(KQ150 일부)에서 flow 결측 → 잔차 산출 종목이 대형주 편향 → 신호가 size 팩터로 오염(orthogonality target #5가 게이트). Inst 0.668은 F+I 합산 시 결측종목 더 늘림.
5) turnover: 매집신호는 빠르게 바뀌어 월간 회전율 高 가능 → 15bps 비용 후 net alpha 침식(turnover_annual 게이트 1100% 한도 근접 위험).
6) novelty=3 정직: 아이디어 자체는 publish됨(Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang). KR long-only 25종목 construction이 fresh part이나, 이미 M39/microstructure FPD와 중복개념 — 동일 데이터로 거의 같은 신호일 위험(중복 4종 중 canonical 선정이나 실측 차별화 미입증).
완화: 1차는 screening tier로 신호력만 먼저 확인(PORT_t 못 넘어도 screen_route로 DPL_FEATURE/OVERLAY_CANDIDATE 라우팅 — measurement-graduation §3 2계층). standalone graduation 기대치는 낮게.

specs.name: C21_Flow_Confirmed_Revision
specs.construction:
SIGNAL: 컨센서스 EPS 상향(revision)을 스마트머니(외국인+기관) 순매수 흐름이 *확인*하는 강도를 곱(product) 상호작용으로 포착. 두 비-수익 정보집합(consensus, flow)의 conditional 결합 — 어느 M*팩터도 둘을 결합하지 않음.

정확한 신호식 (각 sig_date t, 종목 i; 모든 입력은 Date<=t):
  Leg-A (revision, 컨센서스):
    rev_raw(i,t) = w_eps * eps_chg_1m(i, last Date<=t) + w_esbr * esbr(i, last Date<=t)
    기본 w_eps=0.5, w_esbr=0.5 (둘 다 비-수익 컨센서스 신호; grid에서 esbr-only/eps-only도 테스트).
    z_rev(i,t) = z_safe_winsorize(rev_raw(.,t))   # cross-sectional, winsorize 1/99 후 (x-mean)/sd, 횡단면 universe 내
  Leg-B (flow confirmation, 투자자):
    smart_flow_raw(i,t) = frollsum(Foreign, 20, align="right")[i, t] + frollsum(Institutional, 20, align="right")[i, t]
      (= INV01의 분자 + INV03의 분자, 둘 다 KRW 순매수 notional)
    flow_norm(i,t) = smart_flow_raw(i,t) / Size(i,t)   # 시총 정규화 (INV01/INV03 정의와 동일)
    z_flow(i,t) = z_safe_winsorize(flow_norm(.,t))     # cross-sectional z
  INTERACTION (핵심 — product captures conditional info that linear combos miss):
    score(i,t) = z_rev(i,t) * z_flow(i,t)              # PRIMARY spec (variant P)
  단, raw product는 양*양(상향+매수=확인)뿐 아니라 음*음(하향+매도)도 +가 되어 의미 오염 →
  세 variant 정의 (grid):
    (P)  raw_product:  s = z_rev * z_flow
    (G)  gated(권장 1순위, 메커니즘 정합): s = z_rev * max(z_flow, 0)
         → "상향을 스마트머니가 사고 있을 때만 revision-drift 가산, 안 사면 stale로 0 처리"
    (S)  signed_floor: s = z_rev * z_flow, 단 (z_rev<0 & z_flow<0) 사분면은 0 clamp
         → long-only이므로 하향+매도 음음=+ 인공물 제거
  방향: 높을수록 선호(long). C13 준수 — NEGATE/FLIP 금지, z_rev/z_flow는 각각 "높을수록 좋음" 자연 정렬 그대로 product.

장기 비교군(직교/증분력 측정용, 같은 파이프라인으로 동시 산출):
  M_revOnly = z_rev (Leg-A 단독)
  M_flowOnly = z_flow (Leg-B 단독)
  M_linadd = 0.5*z_rev + 0.5*z_flow (선형합 — interaction이 이걸 이기는지가 가설의 핵심 증분 테스트)
  → C21이 M_linadd 대비 portfolio_alpha_t 증분 없으면 "interaction med" 판정(honest_risks 참조).
specs.estimator:
횡단면 z-score interaction (분포자유, 추정파라미터 최소화):
- 각 leg: cross-sectional z_safe_winsorize (winsorize 1/99 후 (x-mean)/sd) — 02_Infrastructure/factor_db/factor_z_standard.R::z_safe_winsorize. universe 횡단면 내에서만, full-sample 통계 미사용(매 sig_date 독립 횡단면).
- interaction: 두 z의 단순 product (또는 gated product). 회귀/공분산 추정 없음 → 추정노이즈 최소.
- 성능 추정 = canonical_screen_bt() 단일 경로 (top_n EW long-only + 15bps delta-cost + 유동성 2e8 + NW lag-3). portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 = forge-authoritative 산식과 동일 함수(build_benchmark_compare). proxy 손계산 금지.
- 증분력 추정: C21 score와 M_linadd score 각각으로 canonical_screen_bt 돌려 ΔPORT_t, Δnet_SR 비교. + 횡단면 Spearman corr(C21_score, M_linadd_score)로 "단순 relabel 여부" 정량화.
- robustness: anchored 3분할 OOS retention(essence_score oos_stat_version=v2, splits {55/65/75} 중앙값) — sig_date 기준 expanding, full-sample tuning 없음.
specs.data_inputs:
CONSENSUS (.cache/consensus/, daily per-metric parquet, columns Date/Ticker/value):
  - eps_chg_1m.parquet  → Leg-A revision (= 기존 C02_EPS_Chg_1m 원천)
  - esbr.parquet        → Leg-A breadth (= 기존 C04_ESBR 원천; Earnings Sentiment Breadth Ratio)
  (로딩: compute_consensus.R 패턴 — CONSENSUS named list, sub[Date <= sig_d])
INVESTOR (.cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet, columns Date/Ticker/Foreign/Individual/Institutional/OtherCorp; KRW 순매수 notional 일간):
  - Foreign, Institutional → Leg-B smart-money 20d frollsum (= 기존 INV01/INV03 원천)
RAWDATA (.cache/rawdata.parquet, columns Date/Ticker/Open/High/Low/Close/Vol/Size/Ret/Sector):
  - Size → flow 시총 정규화 (smart_flow_raw / Size)
  - Vol → 유동성필터 ADV(20d 평균 거래대금 = mean(Close*Vol,20d), t-1) for liq_dt
  - Ret → returns_dt의 forward 1M 실현수익(Ret_1m) 구성 (canonical_screen_bt forward leg)
  - BM_Ret → bench_dt (벤치 active 산출). 단 RAWDATA BM_Ret 결측 이력(메모리 project-rawdata-bmret-empty) → bench는 KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150 cap-w 또는 검증된 BM 시계열 사용, build 전 BM_Ret non-NA 확인 의무.
유니버스: KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 (universe_expanded_v2.R / build_standard_sig_snap의 universe_corp_action_filter, LIQ_20d>=2e8).
재사용 인프라: 두 leg 모두 factor_db에 기존 모듈 존재(compute_consensus C02/C04, compute_investor INV01/INV03) → 신규 컬럼 수집 불필요, feasibility 확정.
specs.lookback_grid:
variant ∈ {P(raw_product), G(gated max(z_flow,0)), S(signed_floor 음음clamp)}  — 1순위 G
flow_window ∈ {20d, 60d}  — 기본 20d(INV01/INV03 정합). 60d는 노이즈 완화 robustness.
revision_leg ∈ {eps_only(w_eps=1), esbr_only(w_esbr=1), blend(0.5/0.5)}  — 기본 blend
top_n ∈ {15, 20, 25}  — 25 hard cap 내. 기본 20.
rebalance = monthly (월말 sig_date)  — 고정(consensus·flow 월간 횡단면 충분)
cost_bps_oneway = 15 (고정, 헌법 cost_model v2.4)
liq_min = 2e8 (고정)
→ 총 격자 3(variant)×2(window)×3(rev_leg)×3(top_n) = 54 cell. 단 이는 sweep이 아니라 가설주도 진단 격자 — selection_type 판정: variant/window/rev_leg는 메커니즘 변형(chain 후보), top_n은 robustness. DSR 적용은 essence_score selection_type 규칙 따름(chain이면 면제, 사전등록 grid면 sweep→DSR HARD). 1순위 사전등록: {G, 20d, blend, top_n=20} 단일 anchor + 나머지는 robustness 진단으로 보고.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
핵심: C21이 "기존 팩터의 relabel/선형합"이 아님을 입증. 횡단면 score-level Spearman corr |ρ| 목표 + canonical_screen_bt 월간 net active return series corr 둘 다 측정.
필수 직교 대상 (must prove low corr):
  1. INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement (기존 flow-agreement 팩터 — C21이 flow leg을 재발명한 게 아님 입증). 목표 |ρ_score| < 0.5.
  2. C19_Composite_Earnings (기존 consensus 합성 — revision leg 재발명 아님). 목표 |ρ_score| < 0.5.
  3. INV10_Smart_Money_Flow (스마트머니 단독). 목표 |ρ_score| < 0.6 (flow leg 공유로 다소 높을 수 있음 — 그래도 interaction이 분리되는지).
  4. C02_EPS_Chg_1m, C04_ESBR (각 leg 원천 marginal). marginal과는 corr 있을 수 밖에 없음 — 측정만, 목표는 *active return series* corr < 0.7.
증분력 핵심 대상 (직교 아닌 "이김" 증명):
  5. M_linadd (0.5*z_rev+0.5*z_flow 선형합). C21(interaction)의 net active return series가 M_linadd 대비 |ρ_active| < 0.85 AND ΔPORT_t > 0 이어야 interaction이 유의. ρ_active≈1이면 interaction은 무의미(honest_risk 발현).
M-cluster 직교 (제안 rationale의 핵심 — flow×consensus는 어느 M*도 안 건드림):
  6. M05/M06/M32(모멘텀군), M-value/quality 군 대표 5종. 목표 active return series |ρ| < 0.4 (둘 다 비-수익 정보 → 모멘텀과 구조적 직교 기대).
측정: _ortho_audit 패턴(active=−BM basis, gross 아님 — 메모리 reference-orthogonality-gross-vs-active 정합). gross corr 보고 금지, active corr 권위.
specs.pit_notes:
C1 (no full-sample): 모든 z-score는 매 sig_date 횡단면 내에서만 산출(per-Date independent). winsorize 1/99도 당월 횡단면 only. OOS retention은 anchored expanding(미래 미사용).
C2 (no same-day circular): score(i,t)는 Date<=t 데이터만. forward 수익 Ret_1m은 [t, t+1M] 실현분으로 returns_dt에 분리(canonical_screen_bt가 scores_dt=t기준, returns_dt=forward로 join).
C3 (no aggregate→apply 동일기간): z 통계는 t시점 횡단면, 적용도 t — 미래기간 집계 없음.
C4 (재무 lag): C21은 재무제표 직접 미사용. 컨센서스 eps_chg_1m/esbr는 애널리스트 추정 시계열(발표일 기준 Date) — compute_consensus의 sub[Date<=sig_d] PIT 필터 그대로 적용. (컨센서스는 발표 즉시 PIT-known이라 45일 fiscal lag 불요, 단 Date<=sig_d 엄수.)
C5 (overlay t-1): 해당 없음(오버레이 아님, 순수 팩터 신호).
C6 (survivorship): universe_corp_action_filter로 당시 생존 유니버스만, 상폐 미제외 편향 없음(build_standard_sig_snap).
C10 (유동성 t-1): liq_dt의 ADV는 t-1까지 20d 평균 거래대금(당일 거래량 미사용). canonical_screen_bt liq_dt=t-1 ADV.
C13 (no NEGATE/FLIP): z_rev, z_flow 모두 "높을수록 선호" 자연 정렬, product도 부호조작 없음. Z_Score_Aligned only.
C14 (IC Usable_Date<=sig_date): 컨센서스/투자자 데이터 모두 Date<=sig_d 필터(compute_consensus 검증된 패턴).
C15 (factor DB load): 본 알파는 .cache의 raw 컨센서스/투자자 parquet을 직접 사용하나, 이는 factor DB parquet(load_month_factors 대상)이 아닌 원천 데이터 캐시 — compute_consensus/compute_investor가 이미 직접 로드하는 승인 경로와 동일. factor DB 합성팩터(C/INV registry) 비교 시에는 load_month_factors() 경유.
flow 20d frollsum: align="right"이므로 t에서 [t-19, t] 사용 — 미래 미포함(INV01 검증 패턴 동일).
build_steps: 1. 데이터 로드(single-thread, arrow::set_io_thread_count(1L) HANG 회피, setDTthreads(1)): rawdata.parquet(Date/Ticker/Close/Vol/Size/Ret/BM_Ret), consensus eps_chg_1m+esbr parquet, investor_wide.parquet(Foreign/Institutional). 메모리 R-segfault 가드(잔류 Rscript taskkill 선행).
2. BM_Ret non-NA 검증(project-rawdata-bmret-empty 재발 방지) — 결측 시 검증된 KOSPI200∪KQ150 cap-w bench로 대체, bench_dt 확정.
3. 유니버스·sig_date 구성: build_standard_sig_snap + universe_corp_action_filter(LIQ_20d>=2e8), 월말 sig_dates 2005~현재. survivorship-free.
4. Leg-B flow: investor_wide에서 종목별 frollsum(Foreign,20)+frollsum(Institutional,20) align=right → smart_flow_raw, /Size → flow_norm. 각 sig_date 마지막 Date<=t 값 추출.
5. Leg-A revision: consensus eps_chg_1m + esbr 각 종목 last Date<=t. rev_raw = 0.5*eps_chg_1m + 0.5*esbr.
6. 횡단면 z: z_safe_winsorize(rev_raw), z_safe_winsorize(flow_norm) per sig_date.
7. interaction score 3-variant 산출: P=z_rev*z_flow, G=z_rev*max(z_flow,0), S=음음clamp. + 비교군 M_revOnly/M_flowOnly/M_linadd 동시 산출.
8. returns_dt 구성: 각 종목 forward 1M Ret_1m(t→t+1M 실현, rawdata Ret 월간 compound via Return-style, 자체합성 금지 — R 브릿지/표준 함수). liq_dt: t-1 20d ADV.
9. canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt=score, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) — variant G/20d/blend anchor 먼저. metric_type=canonical_screen.
10. 직교/증분 측정: C21 vs {INV08, C19, INV10, M_linadd, 모멘텀 5종} active(−BM) return series corr + score Spearman. ρ_active(C21,M_linadd)<0.85 AND ΔPORT_t>0 확인(interaction 유의성 게이트).
11. robustness 격자(54 cell) 진단 산출: variant/window/rev_leg/top_n. oos_retention v2(essence_score). selection_type 판정→DSR 적용 여부.

12. 결과 보고: anchor cell PORT_t_nw_lag3 / net_SR / calmar / oos_retention + 직교 corr 표 + interaction vs linadd 증분 verdict. graduation HARD 3종(PORT_t>=2.95, oos>=0.7, calmar>=0.64)은 forge-authoritative 단계 별도(이 단계는 canonical_screen 실측 screening).
specs.honest_risks:
1. INTERACTION 무의미 위험(제안자 self-flag): flow와 revision이 같은 뉴스에 동반 반응 → mildly correlated → product가 M_linadd(선형합) 대비 증분 없을 수 있음. 방어: build_step 10에서 ρ_active(C21,M_linadd) 및 ΔPORT_t 명시 게이트. ρ_active≈1 또는 ΔPORT_t<=0이면 "interaction med" 정직 보고 → 단, 두 marginal이 각각 비-수익·M-cluster 직교라는 별도 가치는 잔존(rationale 정합).
2. raw product 사분면 인공물: z_rev<0 & z_flow<0(하향+매도)도 product>0 → long-only에서 '확인된 상향'과 혼입. variant G/S로 방어하나, gating이 표본을 줄여 통계력 약화 가능(특히 flow_norm>0 종목이 적은 약세장).
3. flow leg 정규화 노이즈: smart_flow/Size에서 Size(시총) 분모가 소형주에서 변동성 큼 → z_flow 꼬리 불안정. winsorize 1/99로 완화하나 KR 소형주 틸트(메모리: EW-uni 헤드라인 cap-w 대비 낙관 ~+1.3t) 잔존 — cap-w bench 대조 권위.
4. 컨센서스 coverage 편향: eps_chg_1m/esbr는 애널리스트 커버리지 종목만 존재 → 유니버스가 대형주로 축소(KQ150 소형 결측 多). 비교 시 coverage-conditioned universe로 유니버스 일관성 확보 필요(M_linadd도 동일 universe).
5. flow disclosure timing: 투자자 일간 순매수는 장마감 후 공시 → t시점 sig에 t일 flow 포함 가능성. align=right frollsum이 [t-19,t] 사용 시 t당일 flow가 sig_date 의사결정에 PIT-known인지 확인 필요 — 보수적으로 t-1까지(flow lag 1d)로 후퇴 가능(robustness cell).
6. KR SR 천장(메모리 reference-kr-sr-ceiling): 25종목 long-only single-sleeve 팩터선택 SR 천장 ~1.0-1.1, PORT_t>=2.95 graduation HARD는 단독 통과 난망 — 본 알파의 현실적 산출처는 (a) M-cluster 직교 sleeve로 결합 기여(book-marginal ΔIR>=0.05) 또는 (b) DPL feature. standalone 졸업 기대는 과대.
7. 추정노이즈 일반: product는 두 z의 곱이라 노이즈가 곱셈적으로 증폭(분산 ≈ Var 곱). top_n 작을수록(15) 표본 적어 PORT_t 추정 SE 확대 — top_n=20/25 cell이 더 안정적일 것.

specs.name: M36_SignedFlowRun
specs.construction:
Per-stock daily signed run-length of informed (Foreign+Institutional, "smart money") net-buy flow, snapshotted at each month-end sig_date, used as a cross-sectional long-only momentum score. NOT return-derived — built entirely on the investor-flow identity.

Daily signal series (per Ticker, on the PIT-filtered panel Date < sig_date):
  smart_t = Foreign_t + Institutional_t                  # daily net-buy KRW (signed)
  s_t     = sign(smart_t)                                 # {-1, 0, +1}; treat |smart_t| < eps_krw (eps=1e8 KRW ~ 1억) as 0 (noise floor, avoids spurious sign flips on near-flat days)
  RunLen_t = signed consecutive same-sign streak ending at t:
     RunLen_t = 0                          if s_t == 0
              = s_t * (RunLen_{t-1}_abs + 1) if s_t == s_{t-1} (and s_{t-1} != 0)
              = s_t * 1                      if s_t != s_{t-1} (sign flip / restart)
     where RunLen_{t-1}_abs = abs(RunLen_{t-1}); a zero day breaks the streak (next nonzero day restarts at ±1).

Three score variants (signal식 candidates — lookback_grid decides which to test):
  (A) RAW_RUN: score = RunLen_T at the last day before sig_date (signed length of the streak in force at month-end). Positive long streak = bullish, capped at run_cap days.
  (B) MAG_RUN (magnitude-weighted, primary): score = RunLen_T * AvgAbsFlowInRun, where AvgAbsFlowInRun = mean(|smart_τ| over the τ in the current streak) / Size_{t-1}. Couples run-length (the differentiator vs INV09) with per-day intensity normalized by market cap — captures "long AND large" execution programs.
  (C) NET_RUN_RATIO: score = (cumulative net smart flow over the current streak) / Size_{t-1} — signed, size-normalized streak-cumulative flow. Reduces to direction×persistence×size but weighted by the streak boundary rather than a fixed 20d window (this is the structural break vs INV09's fixed-window sign-count fraction).

Sign cap: RunLen clipped to [-run_cap, +run_cap] (default run_cap=10) so a single multi-month outlier streak does not dominate the cross-section. Cross-sectionally rank-transform (or winsorize 1/99 then z-score, C13 Z_Score_Aligned) the chosen variant each month to form the screening score (higher = more preferred). Long-only: select top_n by score (only positive/long streaks rank high; negative streaks sink to the bottom and are not shorted — short leg discarded per KR no-short mandate).
specs.construction_note: Variant B (MAG_RUN) is the designated primary; A and C are ablation controls that isolate whether magnitude-weighting (B vs A) and streak-cumulative framing (C vs A) add signal over raw run-length.
specs.estimator:
Monthly rebalanced cross-sectional screen via canonical_screen_bt (top-N EW long-only, 15bps one-way, contract build_benchmark_compare). Estimation pipeline:
1. Build daily smart-flow panel from investor_wide.parquet (Foreign+Institutional), strictly Date < sig_date.
2. Compute RunLen_t recursively per Ticker via a vectorized run-length encoding (data.table rle-by-group: group consecutive same-sign blocks, assign within-block cumulative count, sign-multiply).
3. Snapshot RunLen / MAG_RUN / NET_RUN at the last available date before each month-end sig_date (.SD[.N] by Ticker, mirroring compute_investor.R's latest-value extraction).
4. Cross-section winsorize(1,99) + z-score (or rank) the score → scores_dt(Date, Ticker, score).
5. Feed scores_dt + returns_dt(Date, Ticker, Ret_1m forward) + bench_dt(Date, BM_Ret) + liq_dt(t-1 20d ADV) into canonical_screen_bt(top_n, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_min=2e8).
6. Read portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3), information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual, period_returns as the authoritative screening metrics (metric_type='canonical_screen', NOT admission-binding).
Also estimate cross-sectional rank-IC (Spearman of score vs forward Ret_1m) per month with rolling/expanding mean (advisory only per measurement-graduation §3). Orthogonality estimated via pooled-and-monthly-median Pearson/Spearman corr of the score against target factors.
specs.lookback_grid:
- variant ∈ {RAW_RUN (A), MAG_RUN (B, primary), NET_RUN_RATIO (C)}
- run_cap ∈ {5, 10, 20, Inf} (streak length clip; Inf = no cap, diagnostic)
- eps_krw noise floor ∈ {0 (strict sign), 5e7, 1e8, 5e8} (KRW threshold below which a day counts as flat/zero — controls sign-flip sensitivity)
- flow_source ∈ {Foreign+Institutional (smart, primary), Foreign-only, Institutional-only} (decompose which investor drives the run)
- score_transform ∈ {cross-section z-score (winsor 1/99), cross-section rank} (rank is the robustness check)
- top_n ∈ {15, 20, 25} (production max 25)
Grid governance: this is a hypothesis-driven sequential chain (1 concept, diagnostic-driven refinement), NOT a sweep — variant/eps/run_cap chosen by IS-only mechanism diagnostics with OOS consulted once on the final pick (measurement-graduation §3 chain rules: selection_type='chain', DSR gate not applicable; record per-iteration change-reason + IS-only selection). Recommended IS-only entry point for first build: variant=MAG_RUN, run_cap=10, eps_krw=1e8, flow=Foreign+Institutional, transform=z-score, top_n=20.
specs.data_inputs:
PRIMARY (flow): .cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet — columns Date, Ticker, Foreign, Institutional, Individual, OtherCorp (daily net-buy amount in KRW; positive=net buy). Confirmed schema from 02_Infrastructure/factor_db/compute_investor.R and parse_investor_quantiwise.R. Production loader: .fdb_env$INVESTOR or arrow::read_parquet fallback (compute_investor.R pattern). Long-format alternative: investor_foreign.parquet / investor_institutional.parquet (Date, Ticker, NetBuy).
SIZE NORMALIZATION: .cache/rawdata.parquet (RAWDATA) — Size column, last value with Date < sig_date per Ticker (size_safe = Size if Size>0 else NA), exactly as compute_investor.R does it.
FORWARD RETURNS: rawdata.parquet Ret → aggregate to forward monthly Ret_1m per Ticker for returns_dt (PIT-aligned: Ret_1m is realized AFTER sig_date).
BENCHMARK: .cache/benchmark.parquet or rawdata BM_Ret → bench_dt(Date, BM_Ret), KOSPI200 total return.
LIQUIDITY: rawdata Close×Vol → 20d trailing ADV at t-1 → liq_dt(Date, Ticker, adv), liq_min=2e8.
UNIVERSE: KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 (apply existing universe mapping; tickers in rawdata Sector/Ticker).
NO external/alt data used. Investor cache last built 2026-06-08.
specs.pit_notes:
C1 (no full-sample): run-length is computed causally left-to-right on each Ticker's daily series; cross-section z-score/rank uses ONLY the cross-section available at each sig_date (no pooling across time). rank-IC reported as rolling/expanding mean, never full-sample. Chain variant selection is IS-only (measurement-graduation §3) — OOS consulted once on final pick.
C2 (no same-day circular): strict inv <- inv[Date < sig_d] before any rolling — sig_date's own investor flow is NEVER used (mirrors compute_investor.R line 100). RunLen_T is the streak as of the last day strictly before sig_date. Size normalization also uses Date < sig_d most-recent value.
C5 (t-1 overlay convention): the monthly score is a t-1-or-earlier snapshot; selection at sig_date uses only past flow.
C7 (auto-detector): run via lookahead_detector.R on the build script; no forward-looking window functions (all frollsum/run-encoding align='right').
C10 (liquidity t-1): ADV computed from data strictly before sig_date (t-1 20d window), passed via liq_dt.
C13 (no NEGATE/FLIP): the long-streak score is positively oriented by construction (long+large flow = high score); no sign negation of an existing factor — Z_Score_Aligned cross-section z-score only. (Negative streaks naturally rank low; we select, not flip.)
C14 (Usable_Date ≤ sig_date): flow rows admitted only if Date < sig_date.
C15 (load via canonical path): flow loaded from investor cache via the compute_investor.R loader pattern (this is the investor sidecar, not the 373-factor parquet — load_month_factors applies only to the factor DB; investor cache has its own audited loader). No raw factor-DB parquet direct-load.
Burn-in: require ≥ min_obs daily observations in the trailing window used to establish the streak (analogous to compute_investor MIN_OBS) so a streak isn't declared on a thin history.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
MUST PROVE (this is the factor's entire rationale):
1. INV09_Flow_Persistence (the critical differentiator) — target |corr| < 0.5 (monthly-median Spearman). INV09 = fraction of last-20d with (F+I)>0, which is sign-blind to consecutiveness. M36 RAW_RUN must show that "10 alternating days" (INV09≈0.5, RunLen≈1) vs "10 consecutive days" (INV09=1.0, RunLen=10) are scored very differently. If |corr| ≥ 0.7, M36 is redundant with INV09 and FAILS its novelty claim — report honestly and route to screen-tier only.
2. M01_Mom_12_1 (price momentum 12-1) — target |corr| < 0.3. Confirms M36 is flow-info, not return-derived.
3. M08_Residual_Mom — target |corr| < 0.3.
4. M24_Sector_Rel_Mom — target |corr| < 0.3.
5. INV01_Foreign_NetBuy_20d / INV03_Inst_NetBuy_20d (level of flow) — target |corr| < 0.6. M36 must add timing-structure (run-length) beyond raw 20d net-buy level.
6. INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement & INV10_Smart_Money_Flow — target |corr| < 0.6 (related smart-money constructs).
Measure on BOTH gross score-level corr (pooled + monthly-median) AND, for the realized sleeve, active-return (−BM) correlation per measurement-graduation §6 (gross corr overstates; active basis is the real orthogonality). Report monthly-median, not pooled, as authoritative.
build_steps: 0. Verify investor cache coverage: confirm investor_wide.parquet date range and ticker overlap with KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150 universe; confirm Foreign+Institutional non-null density (use OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 + taskkill stray Rscript first to avoid the OneDrive+arrow segfault/hang documented in memory; write probe output to a file, not stdout).
1. Load investor_wide.parquet via compute_investor.R loader pattern (.fdb_env$INVESTOR or arrow fallback); coerce Date; setorder(Ticker, Date).

2. Build daily smart_t = Foreign+Institutional; apply eps_krw noise floor → s_t = sign; compute RunLen_t per Ticker via vectorized run-length encoding (rle on sign-blocks, within-block cumulative index, sign-multiply, clip to run_cap).
3. Compute the three variant scores (RAW_RUN, MAG_RUN with Size_{t-1} normalization, NET_RUN_RATIO).

4. For each month-end sig_date in 2005~present: filter Date < sig_date, take .SD[.N] per Ticker → month-end snapshot; merge t-1 Size; cross-section winsorize(1,99)+z-score (or rank) → scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score).
5. Build returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m forward) and bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) from rawdata; build liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv) from t-1 20d ADV.

6. Run canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) for the primary config (MAG_RUN, run_cap=10, eps=1e8, top_n=20). Record portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, IR, net_sr, turnover_annual.

7. Orthogonality audit: load INV09, INV01, INV03, INV08, INV10, M01_Mom_12_1, M08_Residual_Mom, M24_Sector_Rel_Mom for the same sig_dates; compute monthly-median Spearman score-corr (esp. INV09 < 0.5) AND active-return corr of the M36 sleeve vs each comparator sleeve.
8. Run lookahead_detector.R / PIT C-checks on the build script (assert no Date>=sig_date leakage, no full-sample stats).

9. IS-only chain refinement: if primary underperforms, diagnose mechanism (eps too tight? run_cap clipping signal? Foreign-only cleaner than F+I?) and adjust per lookback_grid, recording change-reason; consult OOS once on final pick (selection_type='chain').

10. Report canonical_screen metrics + orthogonality table + honest verdict (PASS / meaningful-fail / redundant-with-INV09). metric_type='canonical_screen' (screening, not admission-binding — forge build_bt_result is authoritative for any capital decision).
specs.pit_notes_extra: Critical reuse: compute_investor.R already enforces inv[Date < sig_d] and t-1 Size — replicate that boundary exactly; the run-length encoding adds no new PIT surface as long as the daily panel is pre-filtered to Date < sig_date before encoding (encoding is causal/left-to-right by construction).
specs.honest_risks:
1. REDUNDANCY WITH INV09 (highest-probability failure): if smart-money flow in KR is highly autocorrelated day-to-day, then sign-count fraction (INV09) and run-length (M36) will be ~0.7-0.9 correlated and M36 adds nothing. This is THE make-or-break test (orthogonality target #1). Novelty=3 reflects this — it is a refinement of INV09, not a new info set. If |corr|≥0.7, honest verdict = redundant, do not promote.
2. RETURN-PREDICTION ≠ STRUCTURE: a multi-day execution-program proxy is plausible, but KR flow may already be priced intraday/next-day; by month-end the run-length may have NO forward 1M predictive power (rank-IC ~0). Flow factors INV01-INV13 as a family have NOT graduated standalone in this system (16/16 long-only admission FAILs were PORT_t, not corr). Expect screen-tier at best.
3. NOISE IN SIGN AT THE eps BOUNDARY: small-cap KR names have thin, lumpy flow → sign flips driven by single large prints, inflating/deflating run-length spuriously. eps_krw floor mitigates but introduces a tuning knob (overfitting risk — kept IS-only).
4. TURNOVER: run-length restarts on every sign flip → score can be jumpy month-to-month → high turnover → 15bps cost erosion (KR long-only TO ceiling ~11x/yr per screening gate). MAG_RUN/NET_RUN smoothing may help but must be measured, not assumed.
5. LONG-ONLY ASYMMETRY: the mechanism (sustained buying = continued pressure) is symmetric, but we can only harvest the long leg (no short). KR β≈0.99 long-only floor means the realized sleeve is mostly market + a thin flow tilt; PORT_t (realized net active) is the binding gate, and standalone flow tilts have historically failed it.
6. COVERAGE / SURVIVORSHIP at the start of sample (early-2000s QuantiWise investor data may be sparse for KOSDAQ150) — burn-in + min_obs guard, but early-period results may be low-information.
7. MISLABEL CARRYOVER: concept is tagged return_math but is flow — ensure registry/feature lineage records is_return_derived=false so downstream (RAMP/FR) orthogonality accounting doesn't double-count it with momentum.

specs.name: Strategic-Corporate (OtherCorp) Accumulation — KR flow alpha (기타법인 net-buy persistence, notional-normalized, sparsity-gated)
specs.construction:
목표 신호: 기타법인(OtherCorp) 일간 순매수가 *지속적*으로 누적되는 종목 = 지배구조 강화/계열사 교차매수/자사주(treasury) 매입 = insider-adjacent conviction. 횡단면 high-score = long 선호.

[단위 정정 — 핵심] investor parser의 OtherCorp는 **순매수수량(share quantity)**이다(parse_investor_quantiwise.R L12 `기타법인: 기타법인 순매수수량(일간)`). 기존 INV01-13은 raw NetBuy(수량)을 Size(시총, KRW)로 직접 나눠 단위 불일치(shares/KRW)가 있다. 본 알파는 **먼저 KRW notional로 변환** 후 정규화한다:
    OC_notional_t(i) = OtherCorp_t(i) * Close_{t}(i)        # 일간 순매수 명목 KRW (t시점 종가, sig_date 이내)
    (Close는 PIT: t 종가는 t 마감 후 알려짐 → 신호는 t-1까지의 누적만 쓰고 portfolio formation은 sig_date 익월. 아래 pit_notes 참조)

신호식 (월말 sig_date d 기준, 각 종목 i):
  raw 누적강도:  ACC40(i,d) = frollsum(OC_notional, 40)_{d-1} / Size_{d-1}(i)
                 # 40 거래일 순매수 명목 누적 / t-1 시총 (flow intensity, INV01 형식과 동일 normalization but notional)
  지속성 게이트:  PERS40(i,d) = (40일 중 OC_notional_t > 0 인 일수) / (40일 중 OC_notional 관측(non-NA)일수)
                 # INV09 Flow_Persistence 형식. one-shot 대량매수 noise 제거, 꾸준한 누적만 보상
  sparsity floor: COV40(i,d) = (40일 중 OC_notional non-NA·non-zero 관측일수) / 40
                 # 49% sparsity 대응 — breadth gate
  최종 score:    SCORE(i,d) = z_xs( ACC40 ) * (0.5 + 0.5 * PERS40)        # persistence로 강도를 0.5~1.0 배율 가중
                 단, COV40 < cov_floor 인 종목은 score = NA (universe에서 자동 탈락)
  z_xs = 횡단면 표준화(해당 sig_date d의 cross-section 내 winsorize 1%/99% 후 z-score). full-sample 통계 금지(C1) — 각 월 cross-section 내에서만.

방향: ACC40·PERS40 모두 클수록 long 선호(부호 그대로). NEGATE/FLIP 금지(C13) — z_score_aligned 그대로 사용.
specs.estimator:
- 신호 산출: 순수 결정론적 rolling 변환(frollsum 40d, persistence ratio, cross-sectional winsorized z). ML/추정 없음 — 1차 검증은 classical signal로.
- 성과 추정: **canonical_screen_bt()** (02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R) — top-N EW long-only, 유동성필터 2e8, 15bps one-way delta-cost, build_benchmark_compare 경유 portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3(NW lag-3) + IR + net_SR 실측. metric_type='canonical_screen'(admission-binding 아님, screening/직교 측정용).
- 직교성 추정: 동일 universe·동일 sig_date에서 SCORE와 기존 INV01/INV03/INV09 및 MOM 팩터 간 횡단면 rank-corr을 월별 산출 → 시계열 평균 |corr| 보고.
- 강건성: lookback_grid 전 셀을 canonical_screen_bt로 돌려 portfolio_alpha_t 표면 확인(단 sweep argmax 선택 시 DSR 게이트 적용 — chain 방식이면 IS-only 선택 + 진단사유 기록).
specs.estimator_note: 기본은 classical. 확장(후속): COV40·PERS40·ACC40을 피처로 한 cross-sectional ML(예 LightGBM rank) 또는 DPL feature로 승격 가능 — 단 1차 검증은 classical canonical_screen_bt로 신호 실재 여부부터 확정.
specs.lookback_grid:
- accumulation window L_acc ∈ {20, 40, 60} 거래일 (제안 중심값 40 = ~2개월, 분기 미만 누적)
- persistence window L_pers ∈ {L_acc} (강도창과 동일하게 고정 — 자유도 축소) 또는 {20, 40} 부그리드
- persistence 가중 형태 ∈ {곱셈 (0.5+0.5*PERS), pure-intensity (PERS 미적용 ablation), hard-gate (PERS40≥0.5만 보유)}  # ablation으로 persistence 기여 격리
- cov_floor (sparsity gate) ∈ {0.30, 0.40, 0.51}  # proposer의 "49% sparsity" → 관측 breadth ≥49%면 0.49 근방; 0.51은 과반관측 strict
- top_n ∈ {15, 20, 25}  # 25 hard cap 내. sparsity로 breadth 부족 시 15/20이 더 안정일 수 있음
- (보조) Size 정규화 분모 ∈ {Size_{d-1}, sqrt(Size_{d-1})}  # 소형주 틸트 통제 ablation

총 핵심 셀 ≈ 3(L_acc) × 3(pers form) × 3(cov_floor) = 27. sweep 시 DSR 게이트 의무. 권장: L_acc=40·곱셈·cov_floor=0.40을 사전등록 primary, 나머지는 강건성 진단.

- universe: KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 (apply_universe_mapping.R / universe_expanded_v2.R 멤버십, sig_date PIT).
- 미사용(금지 준수): 크로스마켓·뉴스·검색·위성 없음. DART 소유구조는 *해석/검증*용 참고만(신호 입력 아님 — 본 1차 스펙은 flow only).
specs.pit_notes:
- C1 (no full-sample): 모든 통계가 rolling(frollsum 40d, align='right') + 각 sig_date cross-section 내 winsorize/z만. 전기간 평균·표준편차 절대 미사용.
- C2/C3 (same-day circular): 신호 누적창은 **d-1까지**(frollsum 시점 d-1 종료). Close notional 변환도 누적 구간 내 각 일의 당일 종가지만, 누적은 sig_date d 직전일까지로 종료 → formation은 d 이후. 같은 월 집계→같은 월 적용 없음.
- C5 (overlay t-1): 본 알파는 overlay 없음(S1 순수신호). regime 미적용.
- C10 (유동성 t-1): ADV는 d-1 기준 20일 평균(canonical_screen_bt liq_dt 호출자 책임 — d-1 PIT로 구성).
- C13 (no flip): ACC40·PERS40 부호 그대로(매수누적=long). NEGATE_FACTORS/FLIP_SIGN 금지 — z_score_aligned only.
- C14 (Usable_Date ≤ sig_date): OtherCorp 일간 데이터는 거래일 마감 후 공시되므로 Usable_Date = 거래일+1 가정. 신호는 d-1까지 누적 → sig_date d에 전부 known. forward Ret_1m은 d→d+1M 실현(절대 신호에 미혼입).
- C15: factor DB parquet 직접 load 아님 — investor_wide는 별도 cache(load_investor_stock 경유, factor_db 아님)이므로 load_month_factors 비대상. 단 rawdata는 표준 cache loader 경유.
- sparsity NA 처리: COV40<floor → score NA → canonical_screen_bt에서 자동 제외(미래참조 아님, 관측 부족의 정직한 탈락). NA를 0으로 임의 대체하지 않음(0 대체는 '매수 없음'을 '중립강도'로 오인 → 정보 누출 아니나 noise). zero-fill은 investor_wide dcast 단계의 fill=0과 구분 — 본 알파는 non-NA·non-zero 관측만 COV에 계상.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
- vs INV01 (Foreign_NetBuy_20d), INV03 (Inst_NetBuy_20d): 다른 투자주체 채널 — 목표 |corr| < 0.25 (서로 다른 거래주체이므로 낮아야 정상. 높으면 '기타법인이 외국인/기관 flow의 그림자'라는 의미 → 독립 알파 가치 약화).
- vs INV09 (Flow_Persistence, F+I 기반): 같은 persistence 구조이나 다른 주체 → 목표 |corr| < 0.35.
- vs MOM (가격 모멘텀 12-1, Factor DB momentum): flow가 가격모멘텀의 프록시가 아님을 입증 — 목표 |corr| < 0.30.
- vs Size/소형주 팩터: sparsity가 소형주에 집중되므로 size 틸트 점검 — |corr(score, log Size)| < 0.30 목표(초과 시 sqrt(Size) 분모 ablation로 교정).
- vs 자사주/buyback 관련 기존 팩터(있을 시): 자사주 anomaly와 중첩 여부 — 중첩 크면 mechanism은 buyback에 흡수(novelty 하락) → 보고.
- 측정: 월별 cross-sectional rank-corr 시계열 평균 + |corr| 분포(p10/p50/p90). 모든 corr는 active-basis 의식(measurement-graduation §6 — gross 상관 과대평가 주의, 단 신호-점수 corr은 return이 아니라 점수 자체이므로 basis 무관).
build_steps: 1. 데이터 로드: load_investor_stock('wide')로 investor_wide.parquet(Date,Ticker,...,OtherCorp) 로드 + rawdata.parquet(Close,Size,Ret,Vol,Sector). universe 멤버십(K200∪KQ150, sig_date PIT) join.
2. notional 변환: OC_notional = OtherCorp(수량) * Close. (Close는 누적창 내 각 거래일 종가, PIT 준수 — 누적은 d-1 종료).

3. rolling 산출(by=Ticker, align='right'): ACC_raw = frollsum(OC_notional, L_acc); COV = frollsum(!is.na(OC_notional)&OC_notional!=0, L_acc)/L_acc; PERS = frollsum(OC_notional>0, L_acc)/frollsum(!is.na(OC_notional), L_acc). 전부 d-1까지.
4. 정규화: Size_lag = 각 Ticker d-1 최신 시총(compute_investor.R L109-112 패턴 재사용). ACC = ACC_raw / Size_lag.
5. 월말 sig_date 슬라이스: 각 월말 거래일의 ACC·PERS·COV만 추출(월간 리밸).
6. cross-sectional 변환: 각 sig_date 내 ACC winsorize(1/99%) → z_xs. SCORE = z_xs(ACC)*(0.5+0.5*PERS). COV < cov_floor면 SCORE=NA.
7. PIT 검증: lookahead_detector.R + validate_label_direction()로 신호 d-1 종료·Ret_1m forward 확인. bear_date_audit 불필요(forward label 아님)이나 Usable_Date≤sig_date 어서션.
8. returns_dt 구성: 각 sig_date d → 익월 실현수익 Ret_1m(rawdata Ret 월간 복리는 R Return.portfolio/contract 경유, 손계산 금지 — canonical_screen_bt 내부 처리).
9. liq_dt 구성: d-1 기준 20d 평균 거래대금(Close*Vol) adv.
10. 실측: canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt=SCORE, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8, cost_bps=15) → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 / IR / net_SR / turnover. metric_type='canonical_screen'.
11. lookback_grid 스윕(27셀): primary(L40·곱셈·cov0.40) 우선, 나머지 강건성. sweep argmax 선택 시 DSR 게이트, chain이면 IS-only.
12. 직교성: SCORE vs INV01/INV03/INV09/MOM/Size 월별 rank-corr 평균·분포 산출.
13. screening 판정: hurdle_gate verdict$screening(신호력) → pass면 screen_route(OVERLAY/FR_RCMA/DPL_FEATURE) 라벨. graduation HARD 3종(PORT_t 2.95·oos_retention 0.7·calmar 0.64)은 별도(자본 아님).
14. 리포트: 2차트(equity vs BM + 연간수익 vs BM)·성과요약·직교표·sparsity breadth(월별 유효종목수)·honest_risks 점검. L-code는 PASS/의미있는 실패만 적립.
specs.pit_label_note: metric_type='canonical_screen' (screening 실측, admission-binding 아님). forge build_bt_result(='backtested', 최적화 weights)와 구분. proxy 손계산·prod(1+r)/cumprod 자체합성 절대 금지(answer-principles·measurement-graduation §1).
specs.orthogonality_summary: 핵심 직교 입증 대상 = INV01/INV03(타 주체 flow, |corr|<0.25), INV09(동형 persistence 타주체, <0.35), MOM(가격모멘텀 프록시 아님, <0.30), Size(소형주 틸트 통제, <0.30). 자사주/buyback 기존팩터와 중첩 시 mechanism 흡수 여부 정직 보고.
specs.honest_risks:
1. **Sparsity breadth 붕괴(feasibility=3 핵심 리스크)**: 49% sparsity → cov_floor 적용 후 월별 유효종목이 top_n(20)을 못 채우는 달이 다수일 수 있음. breadth<top_n인 달은 사실상 over-concentration → noise·turnover 폭증. *완화*: 월별 유효종목수 시계열 필수 모니터(중앙값<30이면 top_n=15로). breadth 부족이 구조적이면 standalone 알파 부적격 → DPL feature/overlay로 라우팅.
2. **수량 NetBuy의 가격 종속**: notional 변환(×Close) 안 하면 고가주 편향, 변환해도 Close가 신호에 혼입(상승종목 notional 자동 증가 → 가격모멘텀 오염). MOM 직교 |corr| 미달 시 ACC를 *주수* 기준 turnover-normalized(Vol 대비)로 재정의 ablation 필요.
3. **기타법인 정체성 모호**: '기타법인'은 자사주(treasury)·계열사뿐 아니라 일반 비금융 법인·SPC·재단 등 혼재 — buyback/control 메커니즘이 신호의 일부에 불과할 수 있음. 순수 flow로는 동기 식별 불가(DART 소유구조 cross-check는 해석용 후속). 메커니즘 4(buyback)가 약하면 rationale의 novelty 근거 약화.
4. **PORT_t 천장(measurement-graduation §6 '직교≠수익')**: orthogonality_potential=5라도 long-only 실현 net active(PORT_t)는 별개 게이트. INV 계열 다수가 직교하나 PORT_t 미통과한 전례(16/16 admission FAIL) — 본 알파도 직교는 통과하되 PORT_t<2.95일 위험 높음. 직교는 결합(FR/RAMP sleeve) 가치이지 standalone 자본 졸업 보장 아님.
5. **이벤트성/희소 대량매수 = 추정노이즈**: 기타법인 매수는 1회성 블록딜·지분취득 공시 이벤트가 많아 persistence gate로도 거르지 못하는 spike 잔존 → ACC 분포 fat-tail, z-score 불안정. winsorize 1/99%로 일부 완화하나 소표본 cross-section에선 여전히 leverage point.
6. **lag/공시 타이밍**: 투자주체별 순매수는 거래일 마감 후 집계되나 KRX 확정/정정 시 t+1 정정 가능 — Usable_Date 가정(거래일+1)이 낙관이면 미세 look-ahead. 1차는 +1 가정, 민감 시 +2 보수 ablation.
7. **decay 가능성**: flow 알파는 crowding/공시투명성 강화로 시간에 따라 약화(measurement-graduation decay-pattern). oos_retention<0.5면 cohort decay 라벨 → screen tier 라우팅(자본 불가).
specs.data_inputs_note: 투자주체 데이터는 factor DB가 아닌 .cache/investor_stock/ 별도 cache(load_investor_stock 경유) — C15 load_month_factors 비대상이나, factor_db 직접 parquet load와 구분해 정식 loader만 사용.
specs.construction_validation: 단위 정정(수량→notional ×Close)이 본 스펙의 load-bearing 차별점: 기존 INV01-13은 raw 수량/Size로 단위 불일치가 있으나 동일 주체 내 횡단면 비교라 무해. OtherCorp 채널을 처음 쓰는 본 알파는 notional 변환 없이는 고가주 편향이 직접 score를 왜곡하므로 ×Close 필수. (단 honest_risk 2의 MOM 오염 trade-off 동반.)

specs.name: Investor-Flow Co-Movement Network Momentum (FlowNet)
specs.construction:
메커니즘: 투자자(외국인+기관) 순매수의 *시계열 유사도*로 종목을 클러스터링하고, 같은 flow-cluster에 속한 "이웃" 종목들의 최근 flow 모멘텀이 아직 자기 종목 가격에 반영되지 않은 부분을 신호화한다. coordinated basket reallocation이 flow-군집 안에서 단계적(capacity staging)으로 전파된다는 가설.

정확한 신호식 (월말 sig_date t 기준, 모두 t 시점에 관측가능):

[0] 일간 per-stock 투자자 순매수 정규화. investor_wide.parquet에서 종목 i, 일자 d의 외국인+기관 합산 순매수 금액 N_{i,d} = Foreign_{i,d} + Institutional_{i,d} (KRW). 거래대금(Close*Vol, t-1 기준 20d 평균 ADV_{i})로 나눠 규모 중립화: f_{i,d} = N_{i,d} / ADV_{i,t-1}. (대형주 절대금액 편향 제거.)

[1] flow 시계열 임베딩. 각 월말 t에서, 직전 W_sim 거래일(grid: 120/250d) window의 f_{i,d}를 종목별 벡터로 만든다. 노이즈 억제 위해 5d EWMA 평활 후 cross-sectional z-score(각 일자 횡단면 표준화 → 시장 공통 flow 성분 제거, market-flow leakage 차단).

[2] flow-affinity 그래프. 종목쌍 (i,j)의 flow 시계열 상관 ρ_{ij} = corr(f_i, f_j) over window. affinity A_{ij} = max(ρ_{ij} - τ, 0) (τ=0.3 임계, 음·약상관 절단). 자기루프 제외(A_{ii}=0). 상위 k-NN(k=10/20)만 보존해 희소 그래프 G_t.

[3] 군집화(estimator 참조). G_t에 그래프 클러스터링(상관거리 1-ρ 기반 hierarchical, 또는 leading-eigenvector/Louvain) → 종목 i의 cluster C(i). cap: 군집 5~50종목.

[4] 이웃 flow 모멘텀. 종목 i의 flow-이웃 집합 = 같은 군집 C(i) 내 다른 종목(자기 제외). 이웃 flow 모멘텀 = affinity 가중 평균:
  NbrFlow_i,t = Σ_{j∈C(i), j≠i} A_{ij} * FlowMom_{j, t-lag} / Σ_{j} A_{ij}
  여기서 FlowMom_{j} = flow_features_daily의 foreign_flow_momentum 또는 inst_netbuy_20d(이미 산출된 rolling 20d netbuy), lag = LAG_NBR 거래일(5/10d, capacity staging 전파지연 포착 + PIT 보장).

[5] own-price 미반영분(co-movement residual). 이웃 flow 신호 중 자기 종목 최근 수익률에 이미 들어간 부분 제거: NbrFlow를 자기 ret_20d에 횡단면 회귀 → 잔차 ε_i = "이웃이 사는데 내 가격은 아직 안 움직인" 부분. 최종 score_i,t = z(ε_i). (높을수록 long 선호.)

[6] 포트폴리오. K200∪KQ150 유니버스, 유동성필터 ADV≥2e8(t-1), score 상위 top_n(20, max25) EW long-only, 월 리밸, 15bps one-way → canonical_screen_bt 실측.
specs.construction_note: 신호는 100% 비-수익률(투자자 순매수 금액)에서 생성 — [5]의 잔차화로 momentum/reversal 직교성 확보.
specs.estimator:
[그래프 추정] flow 시계열 상관행렬은 estimation noise가 크므로(N종목≫T window) shrinkage 필수: Ledoit-Wolf 또는 상관거리 1-ρ에 hierarchical clustering(complete/ward) — RAMP HRP 선례와 동일 계열, 안정적. Louvain/leading-eigenvector(igraph)는 modularity 기반 대안(A/B 비교). 임계 τ·k-NN로 그래프 희소화해 spurious edge 억제.
[잔차화] [5] own-ret 회귀는 월별 횡단면 OLS(rolling 아님, 당월 cross-section만 — full-sample 계수 금지). 다중공선 위험 낮음(설명변수 1~2개).
[score 정규화] 횡단면 z-score(robust: median/MAD 옵션). winsorize ±3σ.
[실측 백테] portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 = canonical_screen_bt → build_benchmark_compare(NW lag-3). proxy 손계산 절대 금지(§1).
[추정기 자율] alpha-research가 cluster method(hierarchical vs Louvain) 및 affinity(Pearson vs Spearman, partial-corr)를 A/B로 선택 가능 — 단 chain 자격(IS-only 변형선택, 진단사유 기록) 준수, 또는 사전등록 grid면 DSR 게이트 적용.
specs.lookback_grid:
W_sim (flow 유사도 window, 클러스터링용): {120d, 250d} — 250d 기본(안정 상관), 120d 민감.
k-NN (그래프 차수): {10, 20} — 군집 밀도.
τ (affinity 임계): {0.2, 0.3, 0.4} — 0.3 기본.
LAG_NBR (이웃 flow 모멘텀 lag, capacity staging): {5d, 10d} — 전파지연 + PIT.
FlowMom 정의: {foreign_flow_momentum, inst_netbuy_20d, (foreign+inst)_20d 합} 3종.
cluster method: {hierarchical-ward, Louvain} 2종.
top_n: {20, 25}.
권고 1차 탐색: chain 모드로 W_sim=250·k=20·τ=0.3·LAG=10d·FlowMom=(foreign+inst)_20d·hier·top20 단일 spec부터(n_trials≈1, DSR 면제, PORT_t 2.95가 다중검정 기보정). grid 전수 sweep 시 DSR≥0.5 HARD 적용.
specs.data_inputs:
PRIMARY (per-stock 일간 투자자 순매수, 검증완료):
- .cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet — Date, Ticker, Foreign, Individual, Institutional, OtherCorp (KRW 순매수 금액). 2000-01-03~2026-03-26, ~1547종목/일. RAW 시계열 = 군집화 입력.
- .cache/flow_features_daily.parquet (PRE-DERIVED, 우선 사용) — Date, Ticker, inst_netbuy_{5,20,60}d, foreign_netbuy_{5,20,60}d, individual_netbuy_5d, inst_flow_momentum, foreign_flow_momentum, inst_concentration, liq_20d. 2000~2026, 3390 ticker. *이미 rolling netbuy/모멘텀 산출됨* → [4]의 FlowMom·이웃신호에 직접 사용(재빌드 불필요).
가격/유니버스/벤치:
- .cache/RAWDATA.parquet — Date, Ticker, Close, Vol, Size, Ret, BM_Ret, K200, KQ150(유니버스 플래그), Sector, Market. ADV_{t-1}=20d mean(Close*Vol). returns_dt의 Ret_1m=월간 forward 실현수익(PIT-aligned). bench_dt=BM_Ret.
ORTHOGONALITY 비교 대상:
- .cache/factor_db/flow_smartmoney_60d.parquet — Date,Ticker,Z_Score (기존 per-stock smart-money flow 팩터, 직교 입증 대상).
NOTE: investor_wide의 일부 일자 Foreign/Inst가 0(KOSDAQ 소형주) — [0] f_{i,d} 산출 시 ADV=0/NA 종목 제외, 군집 최소 coverage(window 내 비결측 ≥60%) 필터.
specs.pit_notes:
C1 (full-sample 금지): 모든 상관행렬·군집·z-score는 sig_date t 직전 W_sim window만 사용(rolling). [5] 횡단면 회귀는 당월 cross-section만(전기간 계수 금지). 군집 멤버십 C(i)는 매월 t에서 재추정 — full-period 고정군집 금지.

specs.orthogonality_targets:
목표 |corr| < 0.30 (active-basis, §6 정합 — gross 아님):
1. flow_smartmoney_60d (.cache/factor_db, 기존 per-stock flow 팩터) — 가장 중요. FlowNet은 *이웃* flow(network propagation)이지 자기 flow가 아니므로 직교 기대. |corr|<0.30 목표(미달 시 신규성 약화 → mechanism 재검토).
2. price momentum (ret_20d / ret_60d 계열) — [5] own-ret 잔차화로 구조적 직교. 목표 |corr|<0.25.
3. inst_netbuy_20d / foreign_netbuy_20d (자기 종목 flow) — FlowNet은 자기 flow 제외(이웃만) → 목표 |corr|<0.30. (자기 flow와 높으면 단순 flow 팩터 재발견.)
4. size(log_mcap) — 군집이 대형주 편중 위험 → 목표 |corr|<0.20, sector-neutral 옵션.
5. Factor DB momentum 패밀리(M05/M32 계열) — 목표 |corr|<0.30.
입증 방법: 월별 횡단면 Pearson corr 시계열의 평균·분포(canonical_screen_bt 잔차 IR 비교 + book-marginal). 1·3 직교가 핵심 신규성 게이트.
build_steps: [S0] PIT-aligned 패널 로드: flow_features_daily.parquet(per-stock netbuy, 검증완료 per-stock) + RAWDATA(Close/Vol/Ret/BM_Ret/K200/KQ150/Sector). 유니버스=K200∪KQ150 시점 플래그. ADV_{t-1}=20d mean(Close*Vol).

[S2] 매 월말 t: 직전 W_sim window flow 시계열 추출 → shrinkage 상관행렬 → affinity A_{ij}=max(ρ-τ,0), k-NN 희소화 → 그래프 G_t.
[S3] G_t 클러스터링(hierarchical-ward / Louvain) → cluster C(i). 군집크기 5~50 cap. *매월 재추정*(C1).
[S4] 이웃 flow 모멘텀 NbrFlow_i = affinity 가중 Σ FlowMom_{j,t-LAG} (j∈C(i),≠i). FlowMom = flow_features의 foreign/inst netbuy_20d. LAG_NBR 적용(PIT).
[S5] own-price 잔차화: NbrFlow를 ret_20d에 당월 횡단면 회귀 → 잔차 ε. score_i,t=z(ε) (winsorize ±3σ).
[S6] scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score) + returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m forward) + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) + liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv) 구성.
[S7] canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) 실측 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 / IR / net_sr / turnover.

specs.honest_risks:
1. [군집 불안정성 — 최대 위험] flow 상관 군집은 월별 멤버십이 흔들려 신호가 군집노이즈를 추적할 수 있음. 완화: shrinkage + k-NN 희소화 + W_sim=250d. 군집 멤버십 turnover를 진단 산출(월간 Jaccard) — 낮으면(<0.5) 신호=군집노이즈 의심.
2. [자기 flow와 비직교 → 신규성 소멸] '이웃 flow'가 자기 flow와 높게 상관하면(군집이 동일 baskets) FlowNet은 기존 flow_smartmoney 재발견에 불과. orthogonality_target 1·3 미달 시 mechanism 실패. KR은 외국인이 KOSPI200 전체를 basket으로 거래 → 이웃≈시장 flow 위험(=[1] 횡단면 z-score로 시장성분 제거가 핵심 방어, 그래도 불충분할 수 있음).
3. [전파 신호 부재] capacity staging(점진 전파) 가설이 KR 고유동 대형주에선 1~2일 내 즉시 반영돼 LAG_NBR 신호가 사라질 수 있음 — KQ150 소형주에서만 유효할 가능성(유니버스 분해 진단 필요).
4. [추정 노이즈] N종목 상관행렬(~300×300)을 250d로 추정 = T<N 비율 위험, spurious edge. shrinkage 필수이나 잔존.
5. [실측 약화 패턴 — 시스템 선례] flow 계열은 rank-IC 강해도 long-only top-N portfolio-alpha t 약한 사례 흔함(§2 Cycle 2 교훈). PORT_t가 advisory rank-IC와 어긋날 위험 — PORT_t를 authoritative로 판정.
6. [pre-2005 coverage] 2000~2004 per-stock flow coverage 75~98%(2005+ ≥98%) → 백테 기간 2005~ 고정 권고(헌법 alpha-search 기간 정합), pre-2005는 robustness check만.
7. [거래비용] 군집 재추정으로 월 turnover 高 가능 → 15bps delta-based 비용으로 net alpha 잠식. turnover_annual 모니터(≤11.0/yr screening 게이트).
8. [feasibility 정정] 개념의 'pre-2010 sparse + investor_stock 재빌드 필요' 우려는 검증 결과 *해소*: investor_wide.parquet(per-stock raw 2000~)와 flow_features_daily(per-stock rolling netbuy 검증완료) 둘 다 존재. 실제 build-cost는 당초 flag보다 낮음 — feasibility는 3→4로 상향 가능.

specs.name: INV14 — Smart-Money Lead / Retail-Lag Sequencing (kr_flow temporal)
specs.construction:
CORE OBJECT = per-stock TEMPORAL ORDERING between smart-money cohort (Smart_d = Foreign_d + Institutional_d, daily net-buy KRW) and retail (Retail_d = Individual_d) over a rolling window of W trading days ending t-1. Hypothesis (Choe-Kho-Stulz foreign edge + Barber-Odean retail lag): stocks where smart money buys FIRST and retail follows mid-diffusion have an INCOMPLETE diffusion at sig_date → positive forward drift. This is NOT contemporaneous agreement (INV08) nor contemporaneous net (INV12) — it is who-moved-first WITHIN the window.

Size-normalize daily flows so magnitudes are cross-stock comparable: s_d = Smart_d / Size_{t-1}, r_d = Retail_d / Size_{t-1} (Size fixed at most-recent t-1 mkt cap, matching compute_investor.R convention).

SIGNAL A — Early/Late Split Lead Score (ROBUST, PRIMARY). Split W into EARLY half (first W/2 days) and LATE half (last W/2 days). SmartEarly/SmartLate = sum(s_d) over each half; RetailEarly/RetailLate likewise. LeadScore_A = (SmartEarly − SmartLate) − (RetailEarly − RetailLate). Positive ⇔ smart front-loaded buying (SmartEarly>SmartLate) while retail back-loaded (RetailLate>RetailEarly) = the sequencing pattern. GATE: emit only if late-half cumulative smart net-buy > 0 (diffusion not reversed) AND (|SmartEarly|+|SmartLate|) > flow_floor so the split is meaningful. Higher = stronger smart-leads/retail-lags.

SIGNAL B — Lead-Lag Cross-Correlation (sequencing-direct, NOISIER, secondary). Window-standardize s_d,r_d (subtract window mean, divide window sd). Lagged cross-correlation of smart LEADING retail by k days: cc(k) = corr(s_{d−k}, r_d) for k in 1..K. LeadLag_B = sum_{k=1..K} w_k·cc(k) − sum_{k=1..K} w_k·cc(−k) where cc(−k)=corr(s_d, r_{d−k}) (retail leading smart), w_k = (K−k+1)/sum (linear decay favoring short lags). Positive ⇔ smart flow at d−k predicts retail flow at d more than the reverse = smart leads. SHRINKAGE mandatory: shrink LeadLag_B toward 0 by James-Stein-style factor λ_i = max(0, 1 − c·SE_i²/Var_cc) where SE_i from window length (≈1/sqrt(W−K)); equivalently multiply by reliability = (W−K)/((W−K)+c). Default c=10.

COMBINED SCORE = z_cs(LeadScore_A) + γ·z_cs(shrunk LeadLag_B), z_cs = cross-sectional z-score at each rebalance (winsorize 1/99% first, C13 Z_Score_Aligned pattern), γ default 0.5 (A is robust anchor, B adds sequencing precision). Long-only top-N selection on COMBINED (higher = better). Report A-only and B-only variants separately to isolate which carries signal (B may be pure noise — honest-risk gate).
build_steps: STEP 1 — Load per-stock flow. arrow::read_parquet('.cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet') → data.table(Date, Ticker, Foreign, Individual, Institutional, OtherCorp). Apply arrow::set_io_thread_count(1) BEFORE read (known HANG bug, measurement-graduation 06-18). Build Smart = Foreign + Institutional, Retail = Individual. setorder(Ticker, Date).
STEP 2 — Build month-end sig_date grid 2005-01..latest (12/yr). For each sig_date, slice inv[Date < sig_date] (strict C2 lag). Per ticker take last W rows; require ≥0.75·W valid days else NA (drop).
STEP 3 — Size normalize: from RAWDATA.parquet take each ticker's last Size where Date < sig_date & Size>0 (matches compute_investor.R lines 112-116). s_d = Smart_d/Size, r_d = Retail_d/Size.
STEP 4 — Compute SIGNAL A (early/late split) vectorized per ticker via data.table .SD halving. Apply late-half smart>0 gate + flow_floor gate.

STEP 5 — Compute SIGNAL B (lead-lag CC) per ticker: window-standardize, ccf at lags ±1..K, weighted asymmetric sum, then shrink by reliability factor. Wrap each ticker in tryCatch→NA (degenerate windows). This is the expensive step; parallelize over tickers (RAM<80%, ≤4GB/proc).
STEP 6 — Cross-sectional winsorize 1/99% + z-score A and shrunk-B at each sig_date; COMBINED = zA + γ·zB. Produce three score panels: COMBINED, A_only, B_only.

STEP 7 — Build returns_dt(Date, Ticker, Ret_1m) = forward 1-month realized return from RAWDATA (PIT: Ret_1m is forward, scores are t-1). Build bench_dt(Date, BM_Ret) from RAWDATA BM_Ret (verify BM_Ret non-empty — known gap, project-rawdata-bmret-empty 06-17; if stale, extend first, do NOT proceed on NA bench). Build liq_dt(Date, Ticker, adv) = 20d avg trading value at t-1 (C10).

STEP 8 — source('02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R'); for each of {COMBINED, A_only, B_only} × each lookback_grid point call canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt=liq_dt, liq_min=2e8). Collect metric_type='canonical_screen', portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual.

STEP 9 — Orthogonality: load INV07/INV08/INV10/INV12/INV13 + MOM via load_month_factors() (C15), align on (Date,Ticker), compute cross-sectional rank correlation of COMBINED score vs each, averaged over months. Report |corr| vs targets.

STEP 10 — Verdict table: PORT_t (authoritative), IR, net_SR, turnover, |corr| matrix, A_only-vs-B_only decomposition. Flag if B_only PORT_t ≈ 0 (sequencing-CC is noise, fall back to A-only). Emit L-code label metric_type=canonical_screen; NO graduation claim (that needs forge build_bt_result).
specs.estimator:
SIGNAL A estimator = deterministic windowed sums (frollsum over early/late halves) — no fitting, robust, low variance. This is the primary estimator and the honest fallback if B fails.

SIGNAL B estimator = lagged sample cross-correlation cc(k)=corr(s_{d−k}, r_d) computed via stats::ccf or manual lag-shift + cor() on window-standardized series, lags k=1..K. Asymmetric weighted aggregation (smart-leads minus retail-leads). MANDATORY shrinkage to combat the flagged estimation noise: reliability multiplier ρ = (W−K)/((W−K)+c), c default 10 — equivalent to a Bayesian shrink of a correlation estimate with effective sample W−K toward 0; longer windows shrink less. Optionally James-Stein cross-sectional shrink of the B-panel toward its cross-sectional mean each month. Degenerate windows (sd≈0, all-zero retail) → NA via tryCatch, never 0-imputed into selection.

COMBINATION estimator = cross-sectional z-score blend (zA + γ·zB), γ tunable. No look-ahead in any estimator: all use only Date<sig_date data; cross-sectional z-scores use only the current sig_date cross-section (not pooled across time → no C1 full-sample stat).
specs.lookback_grid:
Window W (trading days, must be ≥40 per feasibility note): {40, 50, 60, 80}. Default 50.
Max lead-lag K (days, Signal B): {3, 5, 10}. Default 5.
Cross-correlation lag weights: {linear-decay (K−k+1), flat}. Default linear-decay.
Shrinkage constant c (reliability): {5, 10, 20}. Default 10.
Combination weight γ (B relative to A): {0.0 (A-only), 0.5, 1.0, ∞ (B-only)} — the 0.0 and ∞ ends ISOLATE each signal's standalone power (critical diagnostic).
top_n (selection): {15, 20, 25} per max-25 mandate. Default 20.
Rebalance: monthly (12/yr) fixed.
flow_floor (Signal A gate): {0, 1e8/Size} default 1e8-equivalent.
Total core grid ≈ 4(W)×3(K)×3(c)×4(γ) = 144 cells, but treat as hypothesis-driven CHAIN not sweep (selection_type='chain', IS-only variant choice, measurement-graduation §3) — pick W/K/c by IS PORT_t plateau, report γ ends as decomposition not argmax-selection. If genuinely argmax over the 144 grid → DSR gate applies; prefer fixing W=50,K=5,c=10 a priori and only sweeping γ for decomposition.
specs.data_inputs:
PRIMARY: .cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet — columns Date(date32), Ticker(string e.g. A005930), Foreign, Individual, Institutional, OtherCorp (double, daily net-buy KRW; positive=net buy). 10.24M rows, coverage 2000-01-03 → present (verified). Smart = Foreign + Institutional; Retail = Individual.
NORMALIZATION + RETURNS + BENCH: .cache/RAWDATA.parquet — Size (mkt cap for normalization, t-1 last), Ret (daily → compound to forward Ret_1m), Close, Vol (→ 20d avg trading value Vol·Close for liquidity adv), BM_Ret (benchmark; VERIFY non-empty, known gap), Ticker, Date, Sector.
ORTHOGONALITY (load via load_month_factors(), C15, NOT direct parquet): INV07_Retail_Contrarian, INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement, INV10_Smart_Money_Flow, INV12_Supply_Demand_Imbalance, INV13_Foreign_Resid_Individual_*, plus a price-momentum factor (MOM family) and Size.
