NOT USED: .cache/investor/*.csv (those are MARKET-LEVEL daily aggregates, identical across kospi/kosdaq files — NOT per-stock, unusable for cross-sectional ranking). No cross-market / no alt-data.
specs.pit_notes:
C2 (same-day circular): all flow sliced inv[Date < sig_date] STRICTLY (compute_investor.R line 100 precedent). Today's investor net-buy is never used for today's signal.
C1 (no full-sample stat): cross-sectional z-scores use ONLY the current sig_date cross-section; never pool z-stats across the whole time series. Signal-B correlations are computed inside each ticker's trailing W-day window only. No expanding/full-sample moment leaks into a past decision.
C10 (liquidity t-1): adv = 20d avg trading value computed on Date < sig_date only (t-1 PIT), passed as liq_dt to canonical_screen_bt.
C4 (financials lag): N/A — pure flow + price, no financial-statement inputs.
C13 (no sign-flip hacks): retail sign handled by ECONOMIC construction (smart-early-minus-retail-early), via Z_Score_Aligned cross-sectional z, not NEGATE_FACTORS.
C14 (IC usable_date): when correlating with Factor DB factors for orthogonality, Usable_Date ≤ sig_date enforced via load_month_factors().
C15 (no direct factor-DB parquet load): orthogonality factors loaded via load_month_factors(), never raw parquet.
Forward-label direction (data_table_shift_convention): Ret_1m is FORWARD realized (label), scores are trailing (feature) — directions explicit; no shift-sign inversion. Window halving (early/late) uses positional split within already-lagged data, introducing no future info.
Size normalization uses t-1 last Size (Date<sig_date), matching compute_investor.R lines 112-116.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
MUST prove low correlation vs the four CONTEMPORANEOUS cohort-flow factors (the whole novelty claim rests here):
- INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement (contemporaneous same-20d-window smart agreement) — TARGET |rank corr| < 0.30. This is the closest sibling; if corr is high the 'sequencing vs agreement' distinction is empirically vacuous → KILL.
- INV12_Supply_Demand_Imbalance (contemporaneous (F+I−Ind)/total) — TARGET |corr| < 0.30. Shares the smart-minus-retail algebra but with NO temporal split, so a high corr means the early/late split adds nothing.
- INV07_Retail_Contrarian (contemporaneous −retail net) — TARGET |corr| < 0.35 (retail-lag term overlaps).
- INV10_Smart_Money_Flow (contemporaneous smart share) — TARGET |corr| < 0.35.
Secondary (should be naturally low): INV13_Foreign_Resid_Individual_* TARGET |corr| < 0.40; price MOM family TARGET |corr| < 0.25; Size TARGET |corr| < 0.20 (Size-normalization should neutralize cap tilt).
Decision rule: orthogonality_potential=5 claim is CONFIRMED only if max |corr| vs {INV08, INV12} < 0.30. Report full rank-correlation matrix averaged over months. If COMBINED fails but A_only or B_only passes, report the orthogonal sub-signal.
specs.honest_risks:
1. ESTIMATION NOISE (the flagged gating risk): per-stock lead-lag cross-correlation (Signal B) over 40-60d windows has effective N≈35-55 per lag → SE of each cc(k) ≈ 0.13-0.17. The smart-leads-minus-retail-leads difference compounds two noisy estimates; cross-sectional ranking on it may be near-random. MITIGATION: shrinkage + Signal A as robust anchor + explicit B_only diagnostic. LIKELY OUTCOME: B_only PORT_t ≈ 0; signal, if any, lives in A_only. Honest framing — B may be a noise term we carry only to falsify the 'CC adds precision' claim.
2. REDUNDANCY WITH INV08/INV12: the early/late split may collapse to a noisy version of contemporaneous net smart-minus-retail (the sequencing may not be a distinct object empirically). If |corr| ≥ 0.30 vs INV12, the concept is mechanically vacuous → KILL, regardless of PORT_t.
3. DIFFUSION ALREADY PRICED: Choe-Kho-Stulz edge is well-documented; KR retail-lag may already be arbitraged in liquid KOSPI200 names (where smart money trades), leaving signal only in illiquid KOSDAQ150 names that the 2e8 liquidity filter removes → signal disappears post-filter. Check pre- vs post-liquidity-filter PORT_t.
4. LONG-ONLY ATTENUATION: the pattern likely also predicts the SHORT leg (smart sells early, retail holds late = down-drift). Long-only captures only half. Per measurement-graduation §6, long-only β≈0.99 floor + 16/16 standalone PORT_t FAIL precedent — even a real signal may fail PORT_t≥2.95.
5. TURNOVER: month-to-month sequencing scores can be unstable → high turnover (>1100% hard fail). The early/late split (Signal A) is smoother than CC; if turnover blows up, lengthen W or add EWMA persistence.
6. SIGN AMBIGUITY: 'retail follows mid-diffusion' could equally signal a near-COMPLETE diffusion (retail-arrived = top, contrarian) — opposite sign. The early/late gate (late-smart still buying) guards against this but the sign should be validated, not assumed; report both signs of LeadScore_A in IS diagnostics (IS-only choice per chain protocol).
7. ZERO-FLOW SPARSITY: many small-caps have sparse non-zero flow days → degenerate windows. The 0.75·W min-obs gate drops them, but may bias the surviving universe toward large caps (overlaps risk #3).

specs.name: Liquidity Improvement Momentum (Amihud trend, not level)
specs.construction:
CORE SIGNAL = OLS slope (in calendar-time) of daily log-Amihud illiquidity over a 126-day window, sign-flipped so that IMPROVING liquidity (falling illiquidity) scores HIGH. This is a *trend* estimator, not a 2-point ratio (distinct from existing L10/L29).

Per ticker i at signal date t (all data Date<=t):
1. Daily Amihud illiquidity: ILLIQ_{i,d} = |Ret_{i,d}| / DolVol_{i,d}, where DolVol_{i,d} = Close_{i,d} * Vol_{i,d} (KRW notional traded). Use dollar volume, NOT raw share Vol, because KRW price levels differ ~1000x across names and raw-Vol Amihud (as in existing L01/L09) is contaminated by price level. Drop days with DolVol<=0 or NA Ret.
2. Winsorize ILLIQ cross-window at 1%/99% per ticker (jump days, e.g. limit-up/down with thin volume, blow up the raw Amihud). Then LOGILLIQ_{i,d} = log(ILLIQ_{i,d} + eps), eps = 1e-12 on the scaled series (log makes the multiplicative illiquidity process additive → a linear slope is the natural 'percent-per-day trend' estimator).
3. Within the trailing W=126 trading-day window (W in lookback_grid), regress LOGILLIQ on a centered time index tau = (rank_of_day - mean(rank))/sd(rank), tau in roughly [-1.7,+1.7]. slope_raw = beta1 from OLS LOGILLIQ ~ tau (use lm.fit / closed-form cov(tau,y)/var(tau); tau standardized so slope is in log-illiq units per 1-sd of window-time → comparable across names).
4. SIGNAL_raw_{i,t} = -slope_raw (negate: negative log-Amihud slope = liquidity improving = desirable). Higher SIGNAL = liquidity getting better over the window.
5. Quality gate: require >= 0.60*W non-missing daily observations in the window (>=76 of 126); else SIGNAL = NA (illiquid micro-names with sparse trading are exactly where the slope is noise). Also require the most-recent 20d to contain >=10 traded days (signal must reflect *current* liquidity state, not a stale early-window trend).
6. Cross-sectional standardization at each t: z-score SIGNAL_raw across the eligible universe (K200|KQ150), winsorized at +/-3 sd, to produce score fed to canonical_screen_bt. Long-only top-N selection (no negation/flip of the cross-section — C13 compliant; the within-name -slope is a definitional construction, not a cross-sectional sign flip).

ECONOMIC FRAMING: a name whose price-impact cost is structurally falling is becoming investable for liquidity-gated capital (foreign/institutional/pension mandates, index/ETF inclusion screens that use ADV/free-float thresholds). This is slow-moving and front-runs flow — distinct from level-illiquidity (already priced as the illiquidity premium) and from return momentum (carries zero microstructure info).
specs.estimator:
OLS slope via closed form beta1 = cov(tau, LOGILLIQ)/var(tau) computed per ticker with data.table by=Ticker (vectorized, no lapply) — matches the existing compute_liquidity.R idiom (L08/L12/L19/L35 all use in-group lm.fit/closed-form). tau is standardized window-time so beta1 is scale-comparable across names.

ROBUSTNESS VARIANTS to test (estimator grid, pick by IS rank-IC stability BEFORE touching OOS):
(a) OLS on standardized tau (baseline).
(b) Theil-Sen median-of-pairwise-slopes (robust to limit-move outlier days; KR has frequent +/-30% price limits that create Amihud spikes). Compute on a thinned grid (every 3rd day pair) to bound cost.
(c) Decay-weighted OLS: weight day tau by exp(-(W - rank)/halflife), halflife=42d, so recent improvement dominates (a trend that reversed in the last month should not score high).

NO ML, NO HPO sweep — this is a single hypothesis with a small pre-registered estimator/lookback grid evaluated as a hypothesis-driven chain (selection_type='chain' per measurement-graduation §3: variant choice is IS-only rank-IC, holdout/OOS read once at the end). DSR gate therefore does NOT apply; PORT_t>=2.95 + oos_retention>=0.7 + calmar>=0.64 are the binding graduation gates.
specs.lookback_grid:
Pre-registered grid (small, hypothesis-driven chain — NOT a sweep):
- Daily Amihud denominator: {Close*Vol (KRW dollar volume, PRIMARY), raw Vol (secondary, for L01/L09 comparability check only)}.
- Trend window W: {63d (3M), 126d (6M, PRIMARY), 252d (12M)}. 126d is the anchor (matches rationale; long enough to estimate a slope, short enough to be 'momentum' not 'level').
- Estimator: {OLS-standardized (PRIMARY), Theil-Sen, decay-weighted halflife=42d}.
- Recency gate on last-20d traded days: {>=10 (PRIMARY), off}.
- min-obs fraction: {0.60 (PRIMARY), 0.50} of W.
- Rebalance: monthly (signal at month-end t, hold t->t+1), top_n in {20 (PRIMARY), 25}.
PRIMARY config = {DolVol, W=126, OLS-std, recency>=10, frac>=0.60, monthly, top_n=20}. Total enumerated configs kept small (<=18); each reported with n_iterations for audit. Variant selection on IS rank-IC + screening verdict only; OOS/holdout consumed once on PRIMARY.
specs.data_inputs:
rawdata.parquet (.cache/rawdata.parquet, confirmed cols): Date, Ticker, Close, Vol, Ret, K200, KQ150, AdminStock, TradingHalt, BM_Ret, Size, Sector. 
- Signal: Close, Vol, Ret (daily, PIT Date<=sig_date) → DolVol & ILLIQ & log-slope.
- Universe membership: K200==1 | KQ150==1 (confirmed 0/1 flags; 199+149=348 union at 2026-06-19). Use membership AS OF sig_date (the flag column is the PIT membership snapshot in the daily panel).
- Eligibility exclusion: AdminStock==1 OR TradingHalt==1 dropped at sig_date (0/1 confirmed).
- Liquidity filter (canonical_screen_bt liq_dt): adv = trailing 20-day mean of Close*Vol computed on days <= t-1 (C10), liq_min=2e8 KRW.
- Forward return for backtest: returns_dt Ret_1m = realized forward 1M return (next-month, PIT-aligned by harness — scores at t, return t->t+1).

specs.pit_notes: C1 (no full-sample stats): slope is estimated ONLY on the trailing W-day rolling window ending at/before sig_date; cross-sectional z-score uses only the eligible universe at t (no pooled multi-date moments). C2 (no same-day circular): signal at t uses Ret/Close/Vol with Date<=t; portfolio return is forward (t->t+1), never same-day. C3: no 'aggregate-then-apply-to-same-period' — window aggregation feeds NEXT month's holding. C5 (overlay t-1): n/a (no overlay); but the liquidity ADV filter uses t-1 trailing window. C6 (survivorship): universe membership read from the daily panel's K200/KQ150 flags AS OF t (a name that later left the index still counts if it was in at t; a name that later entered is excluded at t) — no forward membership. C7 (auto-detect): construction is one-pass trailing window, lookahead_detector clean. C9: n/a. C10 (liquidity t-1): adv computed on days <= t-1, NOT including day t. C13 (no NEGATE/FLIP): the -slope is a within-ticker definitional construction (improvement direction), NOT a cross-sectional sign flip of a ranked factor; cross-section uses Z_Score_Aligned (higher=better) only. C14 (IC Usable_Date<=sig_date): when pulling L-factors/M-factors for orthogonality, enforce Usable_Date<=sig_date. C15 (no direct parquet for Factor DB): orthogonality factors pulled via load_month_factors(); rawdata OHLCV carve-out is permitted (this is the raw daily panel, not the monthly Factor DB). Winsorization is per-ticker-within-window (no cross-date leakage). eps and clip bounds are constants (not data-fit).
specs.orthogonality_targets:
Must DEMONSTRATE (not assume) low correlation against the existing liquidity/momentum factors that the rationale claims it is distinct from. Measure cross-sectional Spearman corr of the new score vs each, pooled-by-date then averaged, on the K200|KQ150 universe:
- L01_Amihud (252d LEVEL, raw Vol) — target |corr| < 0.30. This is the key claim: trend vs level must decouple.
- L09_Amihud_20d (20d LEVEL) — target |corr| < 0.30.
- L10_Amihud_Ratio (Amihud_20d/Amihud_252d, 2-POINT ratio) — STRICTEST target |corr| < 0.40. L10 is the closest existing factor (a crude liquidity-change proxy); the slope estimator must add information beyond a 2-point ratio or the factor is redundant. If |corr| with L10 > 0.55, the regression-slope framing has failed to differentiate → reclassify as a refinement of L10, not a new factor.
- L29_Illiq_Change (Amihud_63d/Amihud_252d, 2-point) — target |corr| < 0.40 (same rationale as L10).
- M01_Mom_12_1, M08_Residual_Mom (return momentum) — target |corr| < 0.20 (rationale claims zero liquidity info in momentum; verify the new factor is not just a volume-momentum proxy that loads on price momentum).
- L03/L28/L38 (volume momentum ratios) — target |corr| < 0.35 (improving liquidity often coincides with rising volume; must show the price-impact-trend is not merely volume-trend).
Also report active(-BM) residual orthogonality, not just gross, per measurement-graduation §6 (long-only β≈0.99 inflates gross corr). Deliverable: an orthogonality matrix; the factor only advances if it clears L10 AND L29 (the redundancy risk) at |corr|<0.40.
build_steps: 1. Load rawdata via arrow open_dataset (set_io_thread_count(2) to avoid the known >=2 hang/segfault; do NOT use 1). Pull Date,Ticker,Open,High,Low,Close,Vol,Ret,Size,K200,KQ150,AdminStock,TradingHalt,BM_Ret. Filter to a working window per sig_date.
2. Build a monthly sig_date grid = month-end trading days, 2005-01 .. latest (uniform 12/yr, matching RAMP/canonical convention). For each sig_date, slice daily panel Date<=sig_date.
3. Compute DolVol=Close*Vol and daily ILLIQ=|Ret|/DolVol; winsorize per ticker-window 1/99; LOGILLIQ=log(ILLIQ scaled + 1e-12).

4. For each ticker, within trailing W=126d window, compute standardized time tau and OLS slope via closed-form cov(tau,LOGILLIQ)/var(tau) using data.table by=Ticker (vectorized). SIGNAL_raw = -slope. Apply min-obs (>=0.60*W) + recency (last-20d >=10 traded days) gates → NA otherwise.
5. Restrict to eligible universe at sig_date: (K200==1 | KQ150==1) & AdminStock==0 & TradingHalt==0. Cross-sectional z-score SIGNAL_raw, winsorize +/-3sd → scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score).

6. Build returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m) = forward 1M realized return per name (compound daily Ret over month t->t+1 via standard helper, NOT hand-rolled prod — use the harness/contract return builder). Build bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) from monthly BM. Build liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv)= trailing-20d mean DolVol as of t-1.

7. Run canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8). Record metric_type='canonical_screen', portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, net_sr, IR, turnover_annual, calmar.

8. Repeat for the small pre-registered grid (W in {63,126,252}; estimator in {OLS,TheilSen,decay}; top_n in {20,25}); pick PRIMARY by IS rank-IC + screening verdict ONLY (IS-only, chain protocol). Record n_iterations for audit.

9. Orthogonality: pull L01/L09/L10/L29/M01/M08/L03/L28/L38 monthly via load_month_factors() (C14/C15), compute the cross-sectional corr matrix vs PRIMARY score (gross AND active-basis). Gate: must clear L10 & L29 at |corr|<0.40.

10. Screening verdict via hurdle_gate.R (screen_pass = signal force); if it clears screening but fails graduation HARD 3, route to screen_route (OVERLAY_CANDIDATE / FR_RCMA / DPL_FEATURE). If PRIMARY clears PORT_t>=2.95 & oos_retention>=0.7 & calmar>=0.64, hand to risk-research for dossier. Emit L-code (backtested) with metric_type labels.
specs.honest_risks:
1. REDUNDANCY with L10/L29 (highest-probability failure): a 126d regression slope and a 2-point Amihud ratio may carry nearly the same signal (both detect 'illiquidity falling'). If |corr| with L10 or L29 > 0.55, the 'slope vs ratio' novelty (already only novelty=3) collapses and this is a refinement, not a new orthogonal sleeve. This is the make-or-break test.
2. SLOPE ESTIMATION NOISE: Amihud is extremely noisy at the daily level in KR (price limits +/-30%, thin micro-names, frequent zero-volume days). A 126d OLS slope on log-Amihud can be dominated by a handful of jump days. Mitigations (winsorize, Theil-Sen variant, min-obs gate) may not fully tame it; the signal could be unstable month-to-month (high turnover, low oos_retention → decay-pattern FAIL).
3. LIQUIDITY-IMPROVEMENT may be ALREADY-PRICED, not predictive: by the time 126d of improving liquidity is measurable, flow may have already arrived and the re-rating is done → forward alpha ≈ 0 (rank-IC strong but PORT_t weak — the classic measurement-graduation §6 'orthogonal but not profitable' trap; BAB-style port_t<0 risk on a long-only top-25).
4. LONG-ONLY / SMALL-CAP TILT: 'most-improving liquidity' names skew toward small/recently-illiquid stocks re-entering tradability → the long leg loads on size/illiquidity-level, inflating MDD and possibly failing the liquidity filter at the very names the signal favors (selection-survival interaction with liq_min=2e8). May screen-pass on signal but fail calmar.
5. VOLUME-MOMENTUM CONFOUND: improving Amihud is mechanically (rising DolVol). If corr with L03/L28/L38 (volume momentum) > 0.35, the factor is a repackaged volume-momentum, not a price-impact-trend — economically less novel and likely already captured.
6. log/eps SENSITIVITY: near-zero Amihud (very liquid large caps) makes log unstable; the eps and winsor choices could materially move ranks for the most-liquid quintile. Report rank stability to eps perturbation.
7. KR price-limit artifact: a limit-up day = large |Ret| with thin Vol = huge Amihud spike, then normalization; this can masquerade as a liquidity 'trend' that is purely a limit-move artifact, not structural improvement.

specs.name: M35_PermEntropyTrend (Permutation-Entropy-Filtered Trend Momentum)
specs.construction:
Base trend signal × ordinal-complexity quality scaler. Higher score = stronger AND more orderly trend; monotone-increasing so canonical_screen_bt's `setorder(-score)` picks the right tail (long-only).

STEP-A (base trend, reuse M01 convention exactly). Per ticker, on window = RAWDATA[Date <= sig_date], let rets = Ret, n = length(rets), SKIP=21:
  base_mom = prod(1 + rets[(n-252+1):(n-SKIP)]) - 1   # M01 Mom_12_1, 252d skip-last-21d. Requires n>252.

STEP-B (permutation entropy, the novel object — Bandt-Pompe ordinal complexity). On the SAME 252d return window EXCLUDING the last SKIP=21 days (use rets_PE = rets[(n-252+1):(n-SKIP)], length L≈231), with embedding dim m=4, delay τ=1:
  1. Form L-(m-1)τ overlapping vectors v_i = (r_i, r_{i+1}, r_{i+2}, r_{i+3}).
  2. Map each v_i to its ordinal pattern π_i = the permutation that sorts it ascending (one of m!=24 patterns). Ties broken by original index order (deterministic).
  3. Relative frequency p(π) = count(π)/N_patterns over all 24 possible patterns.
  4. Shannon entropy H = -Σ_π p(π)·log(p(π)); normalized PE = H / log(m!) = H / log(24) ∈ [0,1].
     PE→1 = maximally random ordinal structure (white-noise-like path); PE→0 = highly regular/predictable path (smooth monotone or strictly periodic).
  5. Order-complexity = 1 - PE  (high = orderly path). This is the scale-INVARIANT, 0th-order momentum-QUALITY primitive — distinct from Hurst (a self-similarity scaling EXPONENT fit to log-variance vs lag) and from FIP (an up/down sign-COUNT asymmetry). PE counts which of 24 rank-orderings the path traversed; it ignores magnitudes entirely.

STEP-C (combine — multiplicative quality filter on directional trend). Because base_mom can be negative (we only ever go long the top), gate so the scaler rewards orderly UP-trends and never flips sign:
  quality = 1 - PE                       # ∈[0,1], orderliness
  score_raw = base_mom × (1 + GAMMA · quality)     # GAMMA∈grid; quality amplifies, never inverts the sign of base_mom
Then cross-sectionally per Date: winsorize score_raw at [1%,99%] and z-score → `score`. (z-scoring base_mom and quality SEPARATELY then combining is the alternative spec held in lookback_grid as COMBINE_MODE.)

INTUITION: two stocks with identical 12-1 momentum are NOT equal — the one whose price path climbed via an orderly, low-ordinal-entropy trajectory (PE low) has momentum more likely to persist; the one that reached the same return via a high-entropy whipsaw path is fragile. PE is the orderliness meter. The headline test is whether this scaler adds residual IC over M01 alone, not whether M35 beats M01 in raw IC.
specs.estimator: Cross-sectional rank-IC / portfolio screen, monthly rebalance. NO model fitting in-sample for the signal itself — PE and base_mom are deterministic per-ticker statistics on the trailing window (no parameters estimated from the panel). Sig pipeline: (1) compute score per (Date, Ticker) at each month-end sig_date over the trailing 252d window; (2) cross-sectional standardization within each Date (winsor + z); (3) feed `scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score)` to canonical_screen_bt(top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt with adv≥2e8) for the long-only top-N EW realized backtest; portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3) is the authoritative readout. (4) ORTHOGONALITY estimator: monthly cross-sectional OLS of next-month return on [M01_z, M35_residual_z] where M35_residual = residual of cross-sectionally regressing M35 score on M01 (and on M13,M14) each Date — report Fama-MacBeth t on the M35-residual coefficient (this is the actual "does the entropy filter earn its keep" test, per the proposer's residual-IC framing). All estimation rolling/expanding only; no full-sample standardization (see pit_notes).
specs.lookback_grid: Embedding dimension m ∈ {3, 4, 5} (m=4 primary per proposal; m=3 → 6 patterns, coarser; m=5 → 120 patterns, needs longer window). Embedding delay τ ∈ {1, 2} (τ=1 primary; τ=2 = weekly-ish ordinal structure). PE estimation window W_PE ∈ {126, 252} trading days (must satisfy W ≥ 5·m! for stable pattern frequencies: m=4 ⇒ W≥120 ok; m=5 ⇒ W≥252 required). Base trend lookback ∈ {M01 252d skip-21 (primary), M02 126d skip-21} to test whether PE-filtering helps more at 12m vs 6m horizon. GAMMA (scaler strength) ∈ {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} — sensitivity of the multiplicative filter. COMBINE_MODE ∈ {multiplicative (base_mom×(1+γ·quality)), additive_z (z(base_mom)+γ·z(quality)), gate (base_mom where quality≥median, else 0)}. NOTE: this grid is for diagnostic robustness ONLY — selection_type = "chain" (hypothesis-driven sequential refinement, 1 hypothesis = 1 alpha), so DSR gate does NOT apply but EVERY in-grid variant choice must be made IS-only (no repeated OOS lookups) and n_trials logged for audit per measurement-graduation §3. Primary config to report first: m=4, τ=1, W_PE=252, base=M01, GAMMA=1.0, COMBINE_MODE=multiplicative.
specs.data_inputs: SINGLE source — .cache/rawdata.parquet (RAWDATA), loaded once via the standard pattern (NOT Factor DB load_month_factors — this is a raw-OHLC return-math factor, carve-out is the rawdata panel which is the same source compute_momentum.R uses). Columns used: `Ret` (daily simple return → base_mom and PE ordinal patterns; PE uses Ret directly, no need for Close), `Close` (only if a price-path variant of PE is tested; primary spec uses Ret), `Date` (PIT cutoff + monthly sig_date grid), `Ticker` (per-name window), `Vol`×`Close` or `Size`→ adv proxy for the liquidity filter (20d avg traded value ≥ 2e8 KRW; pass as liq_dt with column `adv`). For canonical_screen_bt: `scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score)`, `returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m)` = forward 1-month return aligned so Ret_1m at month t is the t→t+1 holding return (built from RAWDATA monthly resample, NOT same-month), `bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret)` = .cache/benchmark.parquet KOSPI200 total return. NO QuantiWise/DART/FRED/ECOS — this factor is pure return-math by design (data_source = OHLC Ret sequence only). Universe = KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 (apply existing universe membership mask at each Date).
specs.orthogonality_targets: PRIMARY (headline, per proposer's own caveat): residual-IC vs M01_Mom_12_1 — regress M35 score on M01 cross-sectionally each Date, the M35-residual must carry independent Fama-MacBeth t (target: residual coef t ≥ 2.0; if |corr(M35, M01)| ≈ 1 and residual t ≈ 0, the entropy filter is cosmetic → DEMOTE, this is the kill-test). Target raw |corr(M35, M01)| is NOT expected to be low (base is still sign(trend) momentum) — orthogonality is claimed in the SCALER not the level, so the binding test is residual-IC, not unconditional correlation. SECONDARY (the construction-orthogonality claim): |corr(M35, M13_VolAdjMom)| and |corr(M35, M14_RiskAdjMom)| — proposer claims PE is orthogonal to vol-adjusted momentum because entropy is scale-invariant (0th-order) whereas M13/M14 are 1st/2nd-moment scalers; target |corr| ≤ 0.4 with M13 AND M14 to confirm PE is NOT just a disguised vol scaler (CRITICAL FALSIFICATION: if corr(M35,M13)>0.6, the "ordinal complexity" is collapsing into realized-vol and the novelty claim fails). TERTIARY: |corr(M35, M16_TrendFactor MA-cross)| ≤ 0.5 (both are "path orderliness" proxies — must show PE adds beyond MA-cross). Also report corr with M05 (log-price slope R²-flavored trend). Standalone PORT_t (graduation) is a SEPARATE gate from orthogonality — passing residual-IC does NOT imply book-marginal value (§6 "직교 ≠ 수익").
specs.honest_risks: 1. COLLAPSE-INTO-VOL (highest prior): despite the scale-invariance argument, PE on daily returns is empirically correlated with realized volatility in equities (high-vol names traverse more ordinal patterns → high PE). If corr(M35,M13)>0.6 the whole novelty thesis fails and this becomes a relabeled vol-managed momentum — the orthogonality SECONDARY test is the make-or-break. 2. ESTIMATION NOISE: m=4 has 24 patterns; W_PE=252 gives ≈231 vectors ⇒ ~10 obs/pattern — thin, so PE has meaningful sampling error per name, and the cross-sectional ranking of `quality` may be largely noise (signal-to-noise of a 0.x-bit entropy difference across 25 survivors is unproven). m=5 (120 patterns) is far worse without a longer window. 3. MULTIPLICATIVE-FILTER LOADS ON M01: by construction the long side ≈ top-momentum names lightly reordered by orderliness; if the reorder is within the same ~30 names, the realized portfolio is ≈M01 and ΔIR over M01 is ~0 even with positive residual-IC (residual-IC can be real but tiny in active-return terms — the proposer flagged exactly this, capped orthogonality_potential at 3). 4. MECHANISM IS CONJECTURAL: the "orderly trend persists" → future-return link is weaker than the flow-based concepts; PE-to-return has no strong KR empirical precedent (entropy literature is mostly regime-detection, not cross-sectional alpha). 5. KR-SPECIFIC: KOSDAQ150 small-caps have noisier daily returns ⇒ systematically higher PE ⇒ the quality filter may just be a size/liquidity tilt in disguise (guard: also report corr(M35, Size) and check the long side isn't a large-cap concentration). 6. The last-21d SKIP removes the most reversal-prone window but also the freshest ordinal structure — if orderliness decays fast, skipping it may discard the predictive part. 7. TIE-HANDLING in ordinal patterns: KR price grids / limit-up-down days create exact-tie returns (esp. illiquid names) → degenerate ordinal patterns inflate one bucket and bias PE downward; must add tiny deterministic jitter by index OR drop zero-return runs, documented, or PE is corrupted for low-turnover names.
build_steps: 1. Load RAWDATA once from .cache/rawdata.parquet (single-thread arrow: arrow::set_io_thread_count is a known HANG on this box — use read_parquet with explicit col_select=c(Date,Ticker,Ret,Close,Vol,Size,Sector); see memory project-r-segfault). Build monthly sig_date grid (month-ends) and KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150 universe mask per Date.

2. Implement perm_entropy(x, m, tau): form embedding vectors, map to ordinal pattern via order() with index-tiebreak, tabulate over all m! patterns, H = -Σp·log p, return H/log(factorial(m)). Add deterministic jitter (+1e-12*seq_along) before order() to defuse exact-tie degeneracy (honest_risk #7). Unit-test on known inputs: monotone series → PE≈0, iid noise → PE≈1.

3. Per (Date=sig_date, Ticker): slice w=RAWDATA[Date<=sig_date & Ticker==tk]; require n>252; compute base_mom (M01 slice rets[(n-252+1):(n-SKIP)]) and quality=1-perm_entropy(rets[(n-252+1):(n-SKIP)], m, tau). Vectorize over tickers with data.table by=Ticker; clip embedding so last vector ends at (n-SKIP) (PIT C-guard).
4. score_raw = base_mom*(1+GAMMA*quality) [primary]; per-Date winsorize[1%,99%] + z-score → scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score). Assert no row uses Date>sig_date (lookahead_detector pass).
5. Build returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m) = strictly-forward monthly holding return (t→t+1), and adv liq_dt (20d trailing avg Close*Vol, ≥2e8). Load bench_dt from .cache/benchmark.parquet (BM_Ret).

6. Run canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt=adv, liq_min=2e8). Record metric_type='canonical_screen', portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, net_SR, turnover_annual. This is the standalone realized readout.

7. ORTHOGONALITY (the headline): compute M01,M13,M14,M16,M05 scores on identical grid (reuse compute_momentum.R outputs via load_month_factors for the FactorDB ones to avoid recompute drift); per-Date cross-sectional corr(M35, each) → report mean |corr|. Then Fama-MacBeth: residualize M35 on M01 each Date, regress fwd-return on M35-residual, report NW t. Kill-test: if M35-residual t<2 OR corr(M35,M13)>0.6 → demote to 'cosmetic, no residual edge'.

8. Run lookback_grid as IS-only chain diagnostics (selection_type='chain', log n_trials; pick variants on IS metrics only, single holdout read at the end per measurement-graduation §3). Do NOT optimize the grid on OOS.

9. Report: standalone PORT_t vs 2.95 (graduation HARD, likely fails — Tier B expectation), residual-IC verdict (the real deliverable), all orthogonality |corr| with metric_type labels. Hand to alpha-research only the score-construction; alpha-research owns the canonical_screen_bt execution and any DPL-feature routing if standalone fails (failed standalone → DPL input feature per measurement-graduation §5, NOT discard).

specs.name: M33_OvernightMom_IR (Overnight-Leg Return Momentum, intraday-reversal aware)
specs.construction:
CORE SIGNAL — cumulative OVERNIGHT-LEG log return over a 60-126d window, skip last day, long-only momentum (higher = buy).

Definitions (daily, per Ticker, all on the SAME adjusted price basis — VALIDATED: rawdata Open & Close are on identical adjustment, since overnight_d + intraday_d = log(1+Ret_d) to 2.8e-16, and corr(Ret, Close/prevClose-1)=1.0):
  overnight_d = ln( Open_d / Close_{d-1} )        # the gap leg: prev-close -> today-open. PIT: uses Open_d (a t-print) and Close_{d-1}. Computed at end-of-day d.
  intraday_d  = ln( Close_d / Open_d )            # the intraday leg (used for the reversal-aware variant + orthogonality diagnostics)
  c2c_d       = ln( Close_d / Close_{d-1} ) = overnight_d + intraday_d   (exact identity, sanity check)

PRIMARY signal at monthly sig_date t (= last trading day of month; signal is end-of-day-t knowable):
  ON_MOM(t; L, skip) = SUM over d in (t - L_days, t - skip_days] of overnight_d
       i.e. accumulate the overnight leg over the trailing L trading days, EXCLUDING the most recent `skip` trading days.
       Base spec: L = 126 trading days (~6m), skip = 21 (~1m, drop last month to avoid 1M-reversal contamination). Window thus = overnight returns from ~t-126 to ~t-21.

REVERSAL-AWARE VARIANT (the mechanism-faithful one — overnight momentum AND short intraday/recent reversal in one score):
  IR_score(t) = z_xs( ON_MOM(t; L=126, skip=21) )  -  lambda * z_xs( INTRADAY_RECENT(t; k=21) )
       INTRADAY_RECENT(t; k) = SUM over last k days of intraday_d   (recent intraday leg — the noisy/mean-reverting retail leg; subtract it = fade recent intraday strength)
       lambda in {0, 0.5, 1.0}; lambda=0 reduces to PRIMARY (pure overnight momentum). z_xs = cross-sectional z-score within the eligible universe at t.

NORMALIZATION / robustness: per-name, divide ON_MOM by sqrt(n_valid_days) is NOT applied (keep raw sum to preserve persistence signal); instead require min_coverage (>=80% of expected trading days in window non-missing overnight) else score=NA. Winsorize the raw ON_MOM and INTRADAY_RECENT cross-sectionally at [1%,99%] each month BEFORE z-scoring (bid-ask-bounce tail control on KOSDAQ).

UNIVERSE & PORTFOLIO: eligible = (K200==1 OR KQ150==1) at t, on the t-1 PIT membership snapshot; pass liquidity filter (20d mean trading value = mean(Close*Vol over last 20d, as of t-1) >= 2e8 KRW); non-suspended (TradingHalt!=1, AdminStock!=1 as of t-1). Rank by IR_score, take top_n (grid 20/25), equal-weight long-only. Hold 1 month, monthly rebalance.

DIRECTION: higher_better (long the high cumulative-overnight names). This is the OPPOSITE sign and a MULTI-day accumulation vs L39_Overnight_Spread (which NEGATES a single-day gap level) — that sign+horizon flip is the whole orthogonality thesis.
specs.construction_note: All inputs end-of-day-t knowable; forward 1M return (Ret_1m) is the only forward object and is supplied by canonical_screen_bt as the realized leg, never used in signal construction.
specs.estimator:
Real-computation via canonical_screen_bt() ONLY (no proxy hand-calc; metric_type='canonical_screen'). Pipeline:
1. Build daily overnight_d / intraday_d panel from rawdata (single pass, data.table).
2. At each monthly sig_date t, compute ON_MOM, INTRADAY_RECENT, winsorize+z-score cross-sectionally, form IR_score.
3. Build scores_dt(Date=t, Ticker, score=IR_score), returns_dt(Date=t, Ticker, Ret_1m=forward 1M close-to-close realized), bench_dt(Date=t, BM_Ret), liq_dt(Date=t, Ticker, adv=t-1 20d ADV).
4. Call canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) -> contract-grade portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3), information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual.
PRIMARY decision metric = portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (forge-authoritative style, long-only realized active t). rank-IC / ICIR computed ADVISORY only (Spearman of IR_score vs forward 1M return, per measurement-graduation §3). NO PerformanceAnalytics self-synthesis — all portfolio aggregation inside canonical_screen_bt (which routes through build_benchmark_compare / Return.portfolio-equivalent contract path).
specs.lookback_grid:
Cross-product, kept small to limit DSR multiple-testing exposure (treat the full grid as a SWEEP -> DSR>=0.5 HARD applies if argmax-selected; if reported as a single pre-registered base config it is a 1-alpha chain -> DSR advisory). Grid:
  L (accumulation window, trading days): {63, 126, 189}   (~3m, 6m, 9m of overnight legs)
  skip (recent-days excluded): {0, 5, 21}                 (none / 1w / 1m)
  lambda (intraday-reversal subtraction weight): {0, 0.5, 1.0}
  top_n: {20, 25}
BASE pre-registered config (report this as the primary, others as robustness): L=126, skip=21, lambda=0.5, top_n=20.
Total cells = 3*3*3*2 = 54; if any selection-by-performance is done across cells, n_trials=54 and DSR gate is HARD. Recommend: fix BASE, report grid only as sensitivity surface (mean/dispersion of PORT_t), do NOT argmax.
specs.data_inputs:
rawdata.parquet (.cache/rawdata.parquet) columns ONLY (no Factor DB dependency for construction):
  Date, Ticker  (keys)
  Open, Close   (overnight_d=ln(Open_t/Close_{t-1}), intraday_d=ln(Close_t/Open_t)) — VALIDATED same adjustment basis
  Vol, Close    (liquidity: 20d mean of Close*Vol = ADV proxy; t-1)
  K200, KQ150   (universe membership flags; t-1 snapshot)
  TradingHalt, AdminStock  (eligibility screens; t-1)
  Ret           (forward 1M realized -> Ret_1m for canonical_screen_bt returns_dt; ALSO sanity-check c2c decomposition)
  BM_Ret        (benchmark for bench_dt; KOSPI200 total return proxy)
For ORTHOGONALITY measurement only (not construction): Factor DB via load_month_factors(sig_date, factor_names=c('M01_Mom_12_1','M04_Mom_1','M11_ST_Reversal','M29_Mom_5d','M30_Mom_10d','L39_Overnight_Spread','M30_...')) — C15 compliant (load_month_factors() in factor_db_connector.R line 187, never direct parquet).
NOT used: QuantiWise investor flows, DART, FRED/ECOS (pure microstructure alpha — keep clean for orthogonality claim). Cross-market / alt-data: none (compliant).
specs.pit_notes: C1 (no full-sample): all cross-sectional winsor limits & z-scores computed WITHIN month t only (no pooled/expanding stats leaking future); rank-IC reported as rolling per-month then NW-aggregated, never full-sample fit. C2 (no same-day circular): overnight_d uses Open_t with Close_{t-1} (yesterday) — no same-day close in the gap leg; intraday_d uses only day-d prints, signal cut at end-of-day t, return realized over (t, t+1m]. C3: signal aggregation window strictly < t; never aggregate over the holding/forward period. C5 (overlay t-1): universe membership (K200/KQ150), TradingHalt/AdminStock, and liquidity ALL taken on the t-1 PIT snapshot, not day-t. C7: passes lookahead_detector (no negative-lag shift on returns). C10 (liquidity t-1): ADV = mean(Close*Vol) over the 20 trading days ENDING at t-1, never day-t volume. C13 (no NEGATE/FLIP): direction is native higher_better; the intraday-reversal term is a SEPARATE z-scored component subtracted with explicit lambda, NOT a sign-flip of a stored factor (Z_Score_Aligned style — lambda is a modeled weight, documented). C14: any Factor DB join (orthogonality only) enforces Usable_Date <= sig_date via load_month_factors. C15: Factor DB accessed ONLY through load_month_factors() (line 187), never direct parquet. data.table::shift: every shift is explicit backward (shift(x, n, type='lag')); forward Ret_1m label produced by canonical_screen_bt, validated by validate_label_direction()/bear_date_audit before use. skip-last-day parameter additionally removes the most recent days where stale/halted Open prints could create same-stamp artifacts.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
Prove the overnight-leg accumulation is a DIFFERENT linear combination of prices than any total-return cumulant. Target |corr| (cross-sectional rank, pooled-by-month then averaged):
  - L39_Overnight_Spread (single-day NEGATED gap LEVEL): MUST be low/opposite — target |corr| < 0.35. This is the nearest neighbor; M33 is multi-day, un-negated, momentum-direction. If |corr|>0.5, the alpha collapses to L39 and is rejected as redundant.
  - M11_ST_Reversal (1M short-term reversal, total return): target |corr| < 0.30. The skip=21 + intraday-subtraction is designed to NOT be 1M reversal.
  - M04_Mom_1 (1-Month Momentum, total return): target |corr| < 0.40.
  - M29_Mom_5d / M30_Mom_10d (5/10-day total-return momentum): target |corr| < 0.45 (some overlap expected — these are short total-return; M33 is the overnight SLICE only).
  - M01_Mom_12_1 (12-1 total momentum): target |corr| < 0.30 (different horizon and leg).
Method: load via load_month_factors for matched sig_dates, Spearman per month, NW-average. Report the FULL correlation row. Key claim to defend in numbers: corr(IR_score, total-return cumulant over same window) should be well below 1 BECAUSE overnight and intraday legs have opposite sign-autocorrelation — measure corr(ON_MOM, total_126d_mom) and show it < 0.7. ALSO report active-basis (−BM) correlation per §6 (gross corr overstates; long-only β≈0.99 floor). Decision gate is PORT_t, NOT orthogonality — a low-corr sleeve still must clear PORT_t>=2.95 to matter.
build_steps: 1. Load rawdata.parquet with arrow (set_io_thread_count(2) — NOT 1, hangs; col_select=c(Date,Ticker,Open,Close,Vol,Ret,BM_Ret,K200,KQ150,TradingHalt,AdminStock,Size) to avoid full 2.5GB load/segfault). Filter to Date>=2005-01-01 (universe-fixed era per alpha-search 제1원칙) and rows with valid Close.

2. Per Ticker, setorder by Date, compute overnight_d=log(Open/shift(Close,1)) and intraday_d=log(Close/Open). Sanity-assert: max|overnight_d+intraday_d - log(1+Ret)| < 1e-8 (decomposition integrity gate; abort if violated = adjustment-basis break).
3. Drop overnight_d where Open is NA or |overnight_d|>0.6 (limit-day / corporate-action artifact guard, ~halt edges). Record dropped fraction; if >5% for a name in window -> coverage<0.8 -> score NA.

4. Build monthly sig_date grid (last trading day each month). For each t: gather trailing daily panel, compute ON_MOM(L,skip) and INTRADAY_RECENT(k=21) by summing the respective legs in-window; enforce coverage>=0.8.
5. Within month t: winsorize ON_MOM and INTRADAY_RECENT cross-sectionally [1%,99%], z-score each, form IR_score = z(ON_MOM) - lambda*z(INTRADAY_RECENT). Build scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score).
6. Build eligibility at t (membership K200|KQ150 t-1, TradingHalt/AdminStock t-1, ADV>=2e8 from t-1 20d Close*Vol) -> liq_dt(Date,Ticker,adv) and pre-filter scores_dt to eligible names.

7. Build returns_dt(Date=t, Ticker, Ret_1m = forward 1-month close-to-close realized) — produced/validated by the canonical bridge; run validate_label_direction()/bear_date_audit on the forward label BEFORE backtest.
8. Build bench_dt(Date=t, BM_Ret) from monthly compounded BM_Ret.

9. Call canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) for BASE config -> capture portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, information_ratio, net_sr, alpha_annualized, turnover_annual, period_returns.
10. Robustness sweep: loop the lookback_grid cells, store PORT_t surface (report dispersion, NOT argmax). Flag n_trials and DSR per measurement-graduation §3 (sweep->HARD).
11. Orthogonality: load_month_factors for M01/M04/M11/M29/M30/L39 on matched sig_dates, compute per-month Spearman vs IR_score, NW-average, report full row on BOTH gross and active(−BM) basis.

12. Compute OOS retention v2 (anchored 3-split {55/65/75} median Sharpe), calmar, subperiod stability for the graduation hurdle table. Emit metric_type='canonical_screen' labeled result + the 3 HARD gates (PORT_t>=2.95, oos_retention>=0.7, calmar>=0.64) verdict.
specs.honest_risks: 1. RETURN-DERIVED / capacity decay: this is built from prices only — overnight-momentum is a published US effect; KR application may already be arbitraged at K200-large-cap level. PORT_t could land <2.95 (the realized-active gate) even if rank-IC looks fine (the measurement-graduation §3 'rank-IC strong, PORT_t weak' trap is the likely failure mode here). 2. BID-ASK BOUNCE on KOSDAQ150: Open prints on thin KQ names are noisy; the overnight leg can be dominated by microstructure noise rather than informed repricing. Mitigations (winsor, skip-last-day, ADV filter, coverage>=0.8) reduce but do not eliminate; if alpha concentrates in low-ADV names it is non-implementable. 3. KR CALL-AUCTION specifics differ from the US continuous-open the Lou-Polk / Bogousslavsky mechanism assumes — the 09:00 single-auction may NOT concentrate informed flow the same way (kr_fit=4 is a hypothesis, not established); the mechanism could simply not transfer. 4. TURNOVER: short-horizon overnight signal with monthly rebalance may still churn (the underlying signal is high-frequency); if turnover_annual blows past the 1,100% screening cap the 15bps cost can erase the gross edge — net_sr the real test. 5. CROWDING with existing short-term momentum: despite the orthogonality design, M29/M30 overlap could push |corr|>0.45, making M33 a redundant relabel (book-marginal ΔIR<0.05 -> DEFER even if standalone passes). 6. ADJUSTMENT-BASIS fragility: the clean decomposition was verified on one name/window (A005930, 2024); a corporate action where Open and Close are adjusted inconsistently on a single day would inject a spurious huge overnight_d — step-2 integrity assert + step-3 |overnight|>0.6 drop are the guard, but a subtle partial-adjustment would pass and bias the cumulant. 7. ESTIMATION NOISE: z-scoring a sum-of-noisy-legs over 126d on a ~350-name cross-section gives a low signal-to-noise score; rank instability month-to-month could inflate turnover and depress OOS retention (the v2 3-split median is there precisely because a single split would be unreliable). 8. SKIP/REVERSAL interaction: lambda and skip both target the same recent-reversal contamination — they can over-correct (subtract real momentum) or under-correct; lambda is a free parameter and part of the 54-cell sweep, so DSR overfitting risk is real if argmax-selected.
specs.pit_notes_extra: Verified empirically before spec: rawdata Open/Close share one adjustment basis (overnight+intraday = log(1+Ret), max abs err 2.8e-16; corr(Ret, close-to-close)=1.0; Open NA frac ~0.5% on A005930). canonical_screen_bt confirmed present at 02_Infrastructure/contracts/canonical_screen_bt.R with the exact signature consumed in step 9. Competing factor IDs confirmed in factor_registry.json: M01_Mom_12_1, M04_Mom_1, M11_ST_Reversal, M29_Mom_5d, L39_Overnight_Spread (def='Negate (Open-Close_prev)/Close_prev. Overnight gap.' — single-day, negated, level: confirms M33 is sign+horizon distinct).

specs.name: INV14_Flow_Steadiness (Drip vs Block Concentration)
specs.construction:
Signed flow-steadiness: penalize the same 20d net flow when it arrives as one block (low temporal diversity), reward it as a steady drip.

Per Ticker, over the trailing 20 trading days (window ends strictly before sig_date), combined daily institutional+foreign signed flow:
  f_d = Foreign_d + Institutional_d                       (daily signed NetBuy, KRW; Individual EXCLUDED to stay aligned with INV09's smart-money definition)
  NET20  = Σ_{d=1..20} f_d                                 (= the SUM that INV01/03 already capture; sign carrier)
  GROSS20 = Σ_{d=1..20} |f_d|                              (total trading intensity)

Temporal concentration via Herfindahl on the absolute-flow shares (NOT cross-sectional — this is within-window over time):
  p_d = |f_d| / GROSS20                                    (Σ p_d = 1; share of |flow| on day d)
  HHI = Σ_{d=1..20} p_d^2                                  (∈ [1/20, 1]; 1/20 = perfectly even drip, 1 = single block day)

Effective number of active flow days (inverse-HHI, the dispersion statistic the SUM-only INV factors are blind to):
  N_eff = 1 / HHI                                          (∈ [1, 20])

Signed steadiness score (PRIMARY spec, "v_neff_signed"):
  STEADY = sign(NET20) * (N_eff / 20)                      (∈ [-1, +1]); magnitude = how dripped the flow was, sign = net direction.

Economic reading: a stock receiving +KRW X over 20d as a steady accumulation (N_eff≈18) scores +0.9; the same +X dumped on one index-rebalance day (N_eff≈1.5) scores +0.075. Negative-NET20 (steady distribution) scores symmetrically negative. higher_better = sustained-conviction accumulation; the long-only top-25 buys the steadiest net accumulators.

Guards: require GROSS20 > 1e8 KRW (≈ INV05/06 liquidity floor — undefined HHI on near-zero gross is noise) and MIN_OBS_20 valid days; else NA. Cross-sectional z-score within (KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150) at each sig_date before screening (raw KRW shares are already scale-free via the p_d normalization, but z protects against regime-wide flow-intensity drift).
specs.estimator: Deterministic rolling within-window aggregation — no model fit, no expanding regression (feasibility=4 is precisely because there is no estimated beta, unlike INV13's residualization). Pipeline: (1) compute the cross-sectional STEADY score at each monthly sig_date via the compute_investor() pattern (frollsum over 20d, take latest row per Ticker strictly before sig_date); (2) cross-sectional z within the live universe; (3) feed scores_dt(Date, Ticker, score=z_STEADY) to canonical_screen_bt() with top_n in the grid, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt = t-1 20d ADV ≥ 2e8. canonical_screen_bt routes period returns through build_benchmark_compare() → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3) as the authoritative screening metric. No proxy hand-computation anywhere (measurement-graduation §1). Report metric_type="canonical_screen".
specs.lookback_grid: window W ∈ {20, 40, 60} trading days (20 = headline/concept-faithful, 40/60 = robustness for whether steadiness signal needs a longer base; keep N_eff cap = W). top_n ∈ {15, 20, 25} (25 = mandate max; 15 to test concentration vs the long-only β floor). flow_set ∈ {Foreign+Institutional (PRIMARY, INV09-aligned), Foreign-only, Institutional-only} (orthogonality diagnostic — isolates which leg drives any signal). variant ∈ {v_neff_signed (PRIMARY: sign(NET20)·N_eff/W), v_neff_unsigned (N_eff/W only — pure dispersion, magnitude-of-conviction test), v_hhi_interaction (z(NET20) · (N_eff/W) — net flow GATED by steadiness, the cleanest "INV01 but only when dripped" form)}. This is a hypothesis-driven sequential CHAIN per measurement-graduation §3 (1 concept, diagnose→refine: PRIMARY first, only escalate variants if INV09/INV10 partial-correlation check fails), NOT a sweep — variant selection IS-only, DSR gate NOT applicable; n_iterations logged for audit. Total ≈ 3·3·3·3 = 81 cells but evaluated as a chain, not argmax'd.
specs.data_inputs: PRIMARY: investor_wide.parquet (loaded via 02_Infrastructure/factor_db/compute_investor.R → .fdb_env$INVESTOR, fallback .cache/investor_stock/investor_wide.parquet). Columns: Date, Ticker, Foreign, Individual, Institutional, OtherCorp (daily signed NetBuy in KRW — QuantiWise 투자자유형별 일간 순매수). Use Foreign + Institutional (Individual only for the flow_set diagnostic variant). Size for liquidity context taken from .cache/rawdata.parquet (Size column, t-1 latest per Ticker). RETURNS/BENCH for canonical_screen_bt: .cache/rawdata.parquet → Ret (forward 1M realized, PIT-aligned by caller), BM_Ret. Liquidity filter: t-1 20d ADV from rawdata Close·Vol (≥2e8 KRW, C10). Universe membership: KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 at each sig_date. No DART/FRED/ECOS/consensus needed (pure flow second-moment).
specs.pit_notes: C2 (same-day circular): investor data loaded with strict `inv <- inv[Date < sig_d]` — T+1 disclosure lag already enforced by compute_investor() (investor NetBuy is published next-day; the existing INV01-13 use `Date < sig_d`, NOT `<=`, and INV14 inherits this identical filter). C1 (no full-sample): HHI/N_eff are computed only over the trailing W-day window inside each Ticker via frollsum(align="right") — strictly backward-looking, no expanding/full-sample statistic; z-score is cross-sectional within a single sig_date (not pooled-across-time). C10 (liquidity t-1): ADV filter uses t-1 20d average traded value in canonical_screen_bt (liq_dt). C14 (IC Usable_Date ≤ sig_date): all flow days satisfy Date < sig_date by construction. C15 (no direct parquet for Factor DB): INV14 is computed through the compute_investor() bridge in the same registry pipeline (load_month_factors() consumes it once registered); the raw investor_wide.parquet read inside compute_investor is the sanctioned ML/daily carve-out path, identical to INV01-13. C13 (no sign-flip hacks): sign comes from sign(NET20), a genuine directional statistic, not a post-hoc NEGATE. Returns Ret_1m are forward realized — never used in score construction. No look-ahead in N_eff: it is a property of past flow only.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
CRITICAL gate — must clear all three before promotion (measurement-graduation: orthogonal ∧ PORT_t both required; this spec proves the orthogonal half):
1. INV09_Flow_Persistence (sign-COUNT: fraction of 20d with F+I>0) — the proposer-flagged cousin. TARGET |Pearson corr| < 0.45 on the cross-sectional score panel. Mechanism distinction: INV09 counts how MANY days were positive (direction frequency); INV14 measures how the |magnitude| was DISTRIBUTED across days (temporal dispersion). A stock up every day in equal drips and a stock up every day with one giant block both score INV09=1.0 but INV14 differs sharply. If |corr|≥0.45, partial-out INV09 (FWL residualize INV14 on INV09) and re-screen the residual; report ΔPORT_t of the residual.
2. INV10_Smart_Money_Flow (rollsum(F+I,20)/rollsum(|F|+|I|+|Ind|,20) — the MOST dangerous cousin: shares the |flow| denominator family). TARGET |corr| < 0.50. Distinction: INV10 = NET/GROSS ratio (a directional-efficiency scalar, blind to WITHIN-window arrangement); INV14's N_eff is the inverse-HHI of the |flow| SHARES, a second-moment of the same series that is invariant to the net/gross ratio. Two stocks with identical INV10=0.6 can have N_eff=2 vs N_eff=19. This is the key novelty defense — must be demonstrated empirically.
3. INV01_Foreign_NetBuy_20d / INV03_Inst_NetBuy_20d (the raw SUM the concept claims to be orthogonal to). TARGET |corr| < 0.35 for v_neff_unsigned (pure dispersion has near-zero mechanical overlap with the sum); v_neff_signed will correlate more with the sum via the sign term (expect ~0.4-0.6, acceptable since sign is intentionally shared) — report both, and lead with the unsigned/interaction variant if signed overlap is high. Secondary check: INV11_Foreign_Concentration (cross-sectional 90th-pctile flag) — confirm <0.30, since INV11 is cross-stock concentration vs INV14's within-time concentration (genuinely different axis).

Add INV14 block to 02_Infrastructure/factor_db/compute_investor.R mirroring the INV08-INV12 pattern: after the existing frollsum aggregations, compute per-day |f_d| where f_d=Foreign+Institutional, then within each trailing-W window compute GROSS20=frollsum(|f|,W), and HHI via frollsum(|f|^2-style) — implement HHI as Σ(|f_d|/GROSS)^2 using a windowed sum of |f_d|^2 divided by GROSS^2 (HHI = frollsum(f_abs^2,W)/GROSS^2), N_eff=1/HHI, STEADY=sign(NET20)*(N_eff/W). Guard GROSS>1e8 & n_obs>=MIN_OBS_20 else NA. Extract latest row per Ticker (inv[, .SD[.N], by=Ticker]).

2. (Mirror INV12 entry.)

Real-computation screen: pass scores_dt + returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m from rawdata Ret forward-aligned) + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) + liq_dt(t-1 20d ADV) to canonical_screen_bt(top_n=20, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_min=2e8). Capture portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3, information_ratio, net_sr, turnover_annual, metric_type='canonical_screen'.

6. Grid traversal as a CHAIN: PRIMARY (W=20, top_n=20, F+I, v_neff_signed) first; record N_eff distribution + PORT_t. Only if orthogonality passes but PORT_t weak, refine to v_hhi_interaction then v_neff_unsigned (IS-only selection, log n_iterations, DSR gate N/A per chain rules). Robustness on W∈{40,60}, top_n∈{15,25}.

Report card: PORT_t_nw_lag3 vs 2.95 hurdle (advisory at screen tier — screen_pass needs SR≥0.7∧CAGR≥12% OR score≥40∧SR≥0.5), net_SR, calmar, turnover (must be ≤1100% screen / note flow factors are medium-turnover), oos_retention v2 (3-split median), AND the three orthogonality |corr| with verdict. Label metric_type throughout. Route via screen_route (OVERLAY_CANDIDATE / FR_RCMA / DPL_FEATURE) if structurally borderline but signal real.
specs.honest_risks:
1. INV10 collinearity is the central threat (proposer-acknowledged at the INV09 level, but INV10 is closer): N_eff and the NET/GROSS ratio are both functions of the same {|f_d|} series. Empirically a steady drip often co-occurs with high net/gross efficiency, so |corr(INV14,INV10)| could exceed 0.50 — if so the marginal information is small and the factor collapses to a re-parameterization of INV10. Mitigation = v_neff_unsigned (strips the net direction INV10 carries) and FWL residualization; but residual may have near-zero PORT_t (orthogonal ∧ unprofitable, the §6 trap).
2. Estimation noise in N_eff for sparse-flow small caps: KOSDAQ150 names can have many zero-flow days → GROSS20 small, HHI dominated by 1-2 days, N_eff unstable and discretized. The GROSS>1e8 guard helps but may shrink the effective KOSDAQ universe, biasing toward large caps (and thus toward the market-β≈0.99 long-only floor — limited standalone alpha headroom, per the 16/16 PORT_t FAIL precedent).
3. No-forward-signal hypothesis may be wrong DIRECTION: the concept assumes block flow (index-rebalance/one-off) has NO forward signal while drip = conviction. But block buying can also be informed (a fund building a position fast on news) — if so, low-N_eff stocks outperform and the signed factor has the wrong sign; the v_neff_unsigned sign-agnostic test partially hedges, but a genuine sign-flip would only show in the screen, not be assumable.
4. Turnover/capacity: flow-dispersion is a fast-moving short-horizon signal (medium turnover label) — at top_n=15-25 monthly it may breach realistic cost even at 15bps if names churn; report turnover_annual explicitly and do not claim net alpha without the cost-laden canonical_screen number.
5. Long-only β floor: as a single-sleeve flow factor it shares the market component (β≈0.99 active-basis), so even a clean orthogonal signal contributes via residual only — standalone graduation (PORT_t 2.95 + oos 0.7 + calmar 0.64) is a high bar; realistic best-case outcome is screen_route=DPL_FEATURE or FR_RCMA, not standalone capital. State this upfront, do not over-claim from a strong rank-IC (rank-IC is advisory; PORT_t is authoritative).

specs.name: M37_DrawdownRecoverySpeed
specs.construction:
개념: 한 종목의 가격경로를 (peak→trough→recovery) 에피소드로 분할하고, 각 완료 에피소드의 "회복에 걸린 시간 / 하락에 걸린 시간" 비율로 회복속도 비대칭을 측정한다. 두 종목이 동일한 총수익·MaxDD 깊이·52주고가비율을 가져도 회복속도 부호는 정반대일 수 있다 — 즉 magnitude가 아니라 time-geometry 축이다.

[일별 underwater 곡선] 각 Ticker, 일별 누적부 cum_t = cumprod(1+Ret) (D50/D51과 동일 식, compute_defense.R:797). running_max_t = cummax(cum_t). dd_t = cum_t/running_max_t - 1 (≤0, 수중깊이).

[에피소드 분할 — 252영업일 윈도] sig_date 기준 직전 252영업일만 사용. 에피소드 = "신고점(dd=0) → drawdown 진입(dd가 임계 THR 이하로 하락) → trough(국소 최저 dd) → 이전 peak 회복(dd가 0으로 복귀)" 의 완결 사이클. 정의:
  - drawdown_time = trough일 - 직전 peak일 (영업일 수, 하락에 걸린 시간)
  - recovery_time = recovery일 - trough일 (영업일 수, 전고점 복귀에 걸린 시간)
  - 에피소드 인정 임계: depth_thr THR (=trough 최저 dd가 -THR 이하여야 1 에피소드로 카운트; 노이즈 미세 dd 배제)

[신호식] 종목 i, sig_date t:
  RecoverySpeedRatio_i,t = median_e ( log( (recovery_time_e + 1) / (drawdown_time_e + 1) ) )
  여기서 e는 윈도 내 **완료된**(recovery 도달) 에피소드. +1은 0-division 방지(log-ratio, 좌우대칭). median으로 sparse·outlier 강건화.
  높은 값 = 회복이 하락보다 느림(저항력 약함), 낮은 값(<0) = 빠른 회복(수요탄력성 지속). 메커니즘 가설(demand-resilience-persists): 빠르게 회복하는 종목 = 매수수요 견고 → 미래 초과수익. 따라서 **score = -RecoverySpeedRatio** (낮은 비율=선호) 로 long-only top-N 진입. (부호는 lookback_grid에서 양방향 실측으로 확정 — proxy 손계산 금지, canonical_screen_bt 실측만.)

[보조 변형 — 미완료 에피소드 처리, PIT 핵심] 현재 진행중(미완료, 아직 전고점 미회복) 에피소드는 recovery_time 미관측 → **완전 제외**(미래참조 차단). 단 정보손실 보정 변형 RSR_pace: 진행중 에피소드의 "현재까지 경과 회복일 / 하락일"을 우측-절단(right-censored) 관측으로 별도 보조신호화하되 기본 신호엔 미포함(grid에서 ON/OFF 비교).

[완료 에피소드 부족 fallback] 윈도 내 완료 에피소드 < min_episodes(기본 1) 인 종목 → score=NA → 자동 제외(canonical_screen_bt가 NA drop). KR 25종목 universe에서 sparse 문제는 honest_risks에 명시.
specs.estimator:
횡단면 순위 스코어(분포추정 아님). 단계별:
1. 종목별 시계열 통계량 RecoverySpeedRatio = 완료 에피소드 log-ratio의 **median**(평균 아닌 중앙값 — 에피소드 sparse·heavy-tail 강건, D46 Sortino류 robust 관행 정합).
2. 횡단면 정규화: 매 sig_date(월말) 단면에서 cross-sectional rank 또는 z-score(robust: median/MAD). full-sample 통계 절대 미사용 — 각 월 단면 내에서만 표준화(C1 준수).
3. canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt=Date/Ticker/score, returns_dt=forward Ret_1m, bench_dt=BM_Ret, top_n grid, cost_bps=15, liq_dt=t-1 ADV, liq_min=2e8) 로 실측. portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3(NW lag-3) + net_SR + IR + turnover_annual 산출.
4. 추정노이즈 완화: 에피소드 임계 THR·윈도길이·min_episodes를 grid로 흔들어 신호 안정성(부호 일관성) 확인 — 단일 파라미터 cherry-pick 금지(DSR selection_type 고려: grid sweep이면 DSR 게이트 적용 대상).
NW lag-3 t-stat은 forge-authoritative 산식과 동일(measurement-graduation §2). metric_type="canonical_screen" 라벨.
specs.lookback_grid:
테스트 그리드(에피소드 분할은 파라미터-민감 → 광범위 sweep + 안정성 확인. sweep이므로 essence_score selection_type="sweep" → DSR≥0.5 HARD 적용 대상):
- episode_window (영업일): {252, 504} — 252 기본(1년 완결 에피소드), 504(2년, 에피소드 카운트 증가로 sparse 완화) 비교.
- depth_thr THR (에피소드 인정 최소 dd 깊이): {-0.05, -0.10, -0.15, -0.20} — 임계 낮으면 미세 dd 노이즈, 높으면 에피소드 희소. KR 변동성 감안 -0.10 중심.
- min_episodes (완료 에피소드 최소 수): {1, 2, 3} — 신호 신뢰도 vs universe 잔존 수 trade-off.
- aggregator: {median, mean, trimmed_mean(0.2)} — robust 비교.
- pace_variant (미완료 right-censored 보조): {OFF, ON} — 기본 OFF.
- sign: {-RSR(빠른회복 선호), +RSR(느린회복 선호)} 양방향 — 메커니즘 부호 실측 확정.
- top_n: {15, 20, 25} (헌법 max 25 내).
총 grid ≈ 2×4×3×3×2×2×3. 1차는 base config(252/-0.10/min1/median/OFF/-RSR/top20)로 신호 존재 확인 후 sweep. DSR 게이트 회피 위해 base 1건만 chain으로 보고하는 경로도 가능하나, 파라미터 민감도가 binding risk이므로 sweep 정직 보고 권장.
specs.data_inputs:
단일 소스 — OHLCV만(.cache/rawdata.parquet):
- rawdata `Ret` (일별 수익률) → cumprod(1+Ret)로 누적부 곡선·underwater 계산. (Close 직접 대신 Ret 사용 — compute_momentum/compute_defense 규약 정합, 배당·수정주가 일관성).
- rawdata `Date`, `Ticker` (시계열 정렬·횡단면 단면).
- rawdata `K200`, `KQ150` (universe = KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150 멤버십 필터, sig_date 시점 멤버십).
- rawdata `AdminStock`, `TradingHalt`, `UnfaithfulDisc` (관리/거래정지/불성실공시 제외 — t 시점값).
- 유동성 liq_dt: rawdata `Vol`×`Close`(거래대금)의 t-1 20일 평균 ADV ≥ 2e8 (canonical_screen_bt liq_min, C10).
- 벤치 bench_dt: rawdata `BM_Ret` (월별 BM 수익, KOSPI200 total return).
- forward 수익 returns_dt: rawdata `Ret`을 월별 복리 → Ret_1m (t+1월 실현, canonical_screen_bt가 forward-align).
Factor DB·DART·QuantiWise·FRED/ECOS **미사용**(순수 price-path 신호). 직교성 검증 시에만 Factor DB(M01/M06/M17/D50/D51/M12/D46) load_month_factors() 경유 로드.
specs.pit_notes:
C1: 횡단면 정규화(rank/z)는 매 sig_date **단면 내에서만** — full-sample 평균/표준편차 미사용. 에피소드 통계량도 종목별 [Date≤sig_date] 윈도 내 rolling.
C2: same-day circular 없음 — score(sig_date)는 sig_date까지의 가격경로만, 수익은 forward Ret_1m.
C3: 같은 기간 집계→적용 없음(t 신호 → t+1 forward 수익).
C7: lookahead_detector 통과 — cumprod/cummax는 좌→우 누적, 미래 포함 없음.
C10: 유동성 필터 t-1 ADV(당일 거래량 금지).
C14: Factor DB 직교검증 시 Usable_Date≤sig_date.
C15: Factor DB 접근은 load_month_factors() 경유.
★핵심 PIT 리스크(스펙 명시): **미완료 에피소드(현재 수중, 전고점 미회복)는 recovery_time이 미래에 관측됨 → 완전 제외**. trough일·recovery일은 반드시 ≤sig_date인 실현 시점만. recovery 도달 여부 자체가 미래정보가 되지 않도록, 에피소드는 "recovery일≤sig_date"인 것만 카운트(현재 진행중 dd는 신호 기여 0). 이 exclusion이 airtight해야 함(개념의 feasibility=2 binding constraint). 구현 후 bear_date_audit.R/validate_label_direction() PASS 의무. expanding이 아닌 trailing 252/504d rolling window 사용(C1).
specs.orthogonality_targets:
price-derived지만 magnitude가 아닌 time-geometry 축임을 실증해야 함. 목표 |corr| 와 대상:
- M01_Mom_12_1 (12-1 모멘텀, 총수익 magnitude): 목표 |corr|<0.30. 핵심 — 회복속도는 누적수익 부호/크기와 독립이어야.
- M06_High_52w (52주고가비율) & M17_Low_52w: 목표 |corr|<0.30. 두 종목 동일 52w-high여도 회복속도 정반대 가능 — 직교 핵심 증거.
- D50_MaxDrawdown (MaxDD 깊이, magnitude): 목표 |corr|<0.35. **depth는 같아도 time-down/time-up 비율은 독립** — 가장 중요한 직교 증명.
- D51_Ulcer_Index (수중깊이·지속의 magnitude 가중): 목표 |corr|<0.40 (Ulcer는 지속시간 일부 포함 → 다소 높을 수 있음, 0.40 허용·초과 시 신호 재정의).
- M12_LR_Reversal (장기반전): 목표 |corr|<0.30 — 회복속도≠반전.
- D46_Sortino (하방위험조정): 목표 |corr|<0.35.
측정: 매 sig_date 단면 Spearman corr → 시계열 평균(active basis 권장, gross corr는 시장성분 공유로 과대 — §6 measurement). |corr|>목표면 magnitude 누수 → 에피소드 정의에서 depth-정규화 강화(시간만 남기기). 직교 통과해도 PORT_t는 별개 게이트(§6 "직교≠수익").
build_steps: 1. 데이터 로드: .cache/rawdata.parquet에서 Date/Ticker/Ret/K200/KQ150/Vol/Close/AdminStock/TradingHalt/UnfaithfulDisc/BM_Ret 로드(arrow read_parquet col_select 명시 — 풀컬럼 세그폴트 회피, RAMP 06-18 교훈). 단일스레드 set_io_thread_count 미설정 주의(HANG 버그).
2. universe 마스크: 매 sig_date K200|KQ150 멤버십 ∧ ¬AdminStock ∧ ¬TradingHalt ∧ ¬UnfaithfulDisc. liq_dt = t-1 20d 평균 거래대금(Vol×Close) ≥ 2e8.
3. 종목별 일별 underwater 곡선: setorder(Ticker,Date) → cum=cumprod(1+Ret), rmax=cummax(cum), dd=cum/rmax-1 ([Date≤sig_date] trailing window만).

4. 에피소드 분할 함수: peak(dd=0)→drawdown(dd≤depth_thr)→trough(국소 min dd)→recovery(dd 0복귀, recovery일≤sig_date) 완결 사이클 탐지. drawdown_time=trough-peak, recovery_time=recovery-trough(영업일). **미완료(전고점 미회복) 에피소드 제외**.
5. 종목별 RecoverySpeedRatio = median_e log((recovery_time+1)/(drawdown_time+1)). 완료 에피소드<min_episodes면 NA.
6. 횡단면 정규화: 매 월말 sig_date 단면 robust-z(median/MAD) 또는 rank. score = -RSR(기본; sign grid로 양방향 실측).
7. scores_dt(Date,Ticker,score) 빌드 + returns_dt(Date,Ticker,Ret_1m forward 월별) + bench_dt(Date,BM_Ret) 빌드.
8. canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt,returns_dt,bench_dt, top_n, cost_bps_oneway=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) 실측 호출 → portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3·net_sr·IR·turnover. metric_type='canonical_screen'.
9. lookback_grid sweep 실행(부호·THR·window·min_ep·aggregator·top_n). DSR selection_type='sweep' 적용 — base 1건 chain 보고 옵션 분리.
10. 직교성: 각 grid 통과 후보에 대해 load_month_factors()로 M01/M06/M17/D50/D51/M12/D46 로드 → 월별 단면 Spearman corr 시계열 평균(active basis). |corr| 목표 대조표 산출.
11. PIT 감사: validate_label_direction() + bear_date_audit.R PASS 확인(미완료 에피소드 exclusion airtight 검증). asof-toggle 테스트로 look-ahead 부재 입증(RAMP 06-18 패턴).
12. graduation 게이트(measurement-graduation §3): PORT_t≥2.95 ∧ oos_retention≥0.7 ∧ calmar≥0.64 + DSR(sweep) — forge-authoritative만. screening tier(신호력) vs graduation tier 분리 보고.
specs.honest_risks:
실패 가능 메커니즘(feasibility=2 binding 정직 보고):
1. ★에피소드 sparsity(최대 리스크): KR 25종목·252d 윈도에서 완료 에피소드가 종목당 0~3건뿐 → median이 1~2개 표본 위 추정 = 고분산 추정노이즈. universe 상당수가 NA로 탈락하거나, 소수 에피소드 우연이 score를 지배. 504d 윈도·min_episodes 완화로 부분 대응하나 PIT(완료만)와 trade-off.
2. ★파라미터 민감성: depth_thr THR가 에피소드 카운트를 좌우 — THR -0.05↔-0.20 간 score 부호가 종목별로 뒤집힐 수 있음. grid sweep으로 안정성 확인하되, 안정성 없으면(부호 비일관) 신호 자체 기각. cherry-pick 시 DSR 게이트 탈락.
3. magnitude 누수: '시간' 축이라 주장하나 실제론 깊은 dd일수록 recovery_time이 길어 D50/D51과 corr 잔존 가능 → 직교 실패(|corr|>목표). 그 경우 depth-정규화(시간을 dd깊이로 나눔) 필요하나 이는 다시 magnitude 도입 — 순수 time-geometry 분리가 어려울 수 있음.
4. PIT 미세누수: '완료 에피소드만' 규칙이 미묘하게 미래정보(recovery 도달 여부가 sig_date 이후 결정)를 끌어올 위험 — exclusion 코드가 1줄이라도 어긋나면 lookahead. asof-toggle·bear_date_audit 필수.
5. 메커니즘 약함(mechanism=3): demand-resilience-persists 스토리는 간접적 — 빠른 회복이 *미래* 초과수익을 예측한다는 보장 없음(이미 회복=정보 소진 가능). 실제로 +RSR(느린회복=저평가 반등) 부호가 맞을 수도 있어 부호 사전확정 불가.
6. KR long-only β≈1 바닥: 직교 통과해도 PORT_t(실현 net active) 미통과 가능(§6 16/16 FAIL 선례 — 직교≠수익). screening tier 통과해도 graduation(자본)은 별개.
7. 구현 비용: 에피소드 분할은 per-ticker 루프·국소최저 탐지로 vectorize 난해 → 373팩터 대비 느림. 우선순위 Tier B 정합(탐색 가치는 있으나 high implementation/estimation risk).

specs.name: M38_SkewnessMomentum (Change-in-Realized-Skewness, Δskew_63d)
specs.construction:
신호 = 종목별 63거래일 실현왜도(realized skewness)의 63거래일 전 대비 변화량(Δ), 횡단면 z-score로 표준화. 부호방향은 KR 실측에서 결정(가설: 좌측왜도 완화 = 크래시리스크 리프라이싱 → 변화가 +(왜도 상승)인 종목 선호; 단 reversal 부호 가능성도 양방향 테스트).

정확한 신호식 (sig_date = t, 모든 입력 Date <= t):
  s_i(t)     = skew( Ret_i[t-62 .. t] )            # 직전 63거래일 일간수익 실현왜도 (현재 윈도우)
  s_i(t-63)  = skew( Ret_i[t-125 .. t-63] )        # 그 63일 전 동일길이 윈도우 (비중첩)
  raw_i(t)   = s_i(t) - s_i(t-63)                  # change-in-skewness (모멘텀 프레이밍)
  signal_i(t)= cross-sectional z-score( raw_i(t) ) over universe at t
  direction-test: score_i = +signal_i (가설1: 왜도상승선호) AND score_i = -signal_i (가설2: 반전) 둘 다 canonical_screen_bt에 투입해 PORT_t 부호로 채택방향 결정 (KR-test로 direction 확정 — 제안자 admission). 단 양방향 시도 = n_trials=2 selection이므로 measurement-graduation §3 DSR 게이트 trigger 여부 명시 (아래 honest_risks).

skew() 정의: 표본 3차 표준화적률 g1 = (1/n) Σ((r-μ)/σ)^3 (population skewness, type 1). σ는 동일 윈도우 표본 표준편차. n_eff(유효 관측치) < 40 인 종목은 NA 처리(노이즈 차단).
specs.estimator: 횡단면 long-only top-N EW 스크리닝(시스템 canonical 표준). raw 왜도변화 → 월말 횡단면 z-score → top_n 선택. 왜도 추정 = rolling 63d window 표본왜도(moments::skewness type 1 또는 직접 g1 계산, data.table frollapply로 PIT-safe rolling). 두 윈도우 차분이므로 추정노이즈 증폭 방지 위해 (a) n_eff>=40 필터, (b) winsorize raw at [1%,99%] 횡단면, (c) optional robust skewness 변형(Bowley quantile skewness)을 estimator A/B로 병행 비교. 성과측정 = canonical_screen_bt() (top-N EW, 15bps one-way delta-cost, 2e8 유동성필터, contract build_benchmark_compare 경유 portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). proxy 손계산 절대 금지 (measurement-graduation §1).
specs.lookback_grid: window_now/window_prev (대칭, 비중첩 차분): {21, 42, 63, 126} 거래일 — 기본 63d. lag_gap(두 윈도우 간격): {window} (비중첩 인접, 기본) + {window/2}(50% 중첩) robustness용. top_n: {15, 20, 25} (헌법 max 25, 기본 20). skip(신호↔편입 갭): {0} (월말 sig_date, 익월 첫영업일 편입 — canonical 월간 리밸 기본). winsorize: {none, [1%,99%]}. skew_estimator: {moment_g1, bowley_quantile}(robust A/B). direction: {+, -}(부호 KR-test, 채택은 PORT_t 부호 일치 1개만). 1차 권장 셀: window=63, top_n=20, winsorize=[1%,99%], estimator=moment_g1, direction 양방향.
specs.data_inputs: rawdata.parquet (.cache/rawdata.parquet, 13.97M rows, Date 1990~2026): 컬럼 Date, Ticker, Ret(일간수익 — 왜도 입력 유일 소스), Close(검증/대체), Vol·Size(유동성 ADV = Close·Vol 또는 거래대금 proxy, 20d 평균, t-1 PIT), K200·KQ150(유니버스 멤버십 플래그), BM_Ret(벤치마크 — bench_dt). 유니버스 = K200==1 OR KQ150==1 (KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150). 기간 = 2005-01~2026-06 (alpha-search 모드 mandate 2005~ 고정). 외부소스 불필요(순수 return-derived). 직교성 검증용으로만 Factor DB(load_month_factors 경유, C15)에서 D43_Skewness/M22_Max_Return/M01_Mom_12_1/M13_VolAdj_Mom/D44_Kurtosis/D16_Coskewness 로드. DART/QuantiWise/FRED/ECOS 미사용.
specs.pit_notes: 중복필드 — estimator/lookback 참조용 무시 가능. 실제 PIT는 위 pit_notes 본문.
specs.orthogonality_targets:
필수 직교 입증 (이 팩터의 존재이유 = 기존 moment/level 팩터와 독립):
1. D43_Skewness (정적 실현왜도 *레벨*) — ★최우선. 변화 vs 레벨 직교가 novelty 전부. 목표 |corr(Δskew_z, D43_level_z)| < 0.30 (횡단면 평균 corr, 월별 IC-style). corr 높으면 팩터 기각(변화≈레벨 = 신규성 무효).
2. M22_Max_Return / D05_MaxRet (단일 극단 차수통계 lottery) — 목표 |corr| < 0.25 (분포변화 vs 단일극값 구분).
3. M01_Mom_12_1 (1차 적률 = 평균수익 모멘텀) — 목표 |corr| < 0.20 (3차적률변화는 평균과 구성상 독립 주장).
4. M13_VolAdj_Mom / D04_RealizedVol (2차 적률) — 목표 |corr| < 0.20.
5. D44_Kurtosis (4차 적률 레벨) — 목표 |corr| < 0.30 (인접 적률차수 분리).
보조: D16_Coskewness / R13_NCSKEW (시장-조건부 왜도) — 목표 |corr| < 0.35. 측정 = 월별 횡단면 Spearman corr 의 시계열 평균 + 분포(5%/95%). orthogonality_potential=4 주장 검증 = D43/M22/M01 3축 모두 |corr|<0.30 충족 시에만 "moment-order orthogonal" 라벨 부여, 미충족 시 정직히 redundant 보고(measurement §6 직교≠수익 동시 적용).
specs.honest_risks:
1. ★추정노이즈 증폭 (feasibility=3 핵심): 63d 일간수익 표본왜도는 고노이즈(3차적률은 극값에 민감, n=63은 왜도 SE≈sqrt(6/63)≈0.31). 두 노이즈 추정치 *차분*은 노이즈를 추가 증폭(Var(Δ)≈2·Var(s) when 비중첩) → 신호 대 잡음비 매우 낮을 위험. 완화: n_eff>=40, winsorize, robust(Bowley) A/B. 차분이 순수노이즈면 PORT_t≈0 + turnover 과다(매월 종목 대거 교체)로 비용에 잠식 — 기각 사유.
2. ★방향 부정확/post-hoc (mechanism=3 약점): 제안자가 부호를 KR-test로 결정 → 양방향(+/−) 시도는 selection. measurement-graduation §3: 이것이 'chain'(가설주도 순차개선)이 아니라 'sweep'(2-방향 argmax PORT_t pick)이면 DSR>=0.5 HARD 게이트 trigger. ex-ante 인과주장 약함 = 한쪽 방향이 우연히 통과해도 과적합 의심. 정직 처리: 양방향을 단일 사전등록 가설셋(n_trials=2)으로 라벨, DSR 산출·기록, 통과 방향에 mechanism 사후합리화 금지.
3. 레벨과의 잠재 redundancy: Δskew가 mean-reverting이면 Δskew ≈ −level (왜도 평균회귀) → D43 레벨과 음의 상관 → 직교성 주장 붕괴. orthogonality_targets #1로 실측 차단.
4. KR long-only β≈0.99 바닥 (measurement §6): 직교라도 PORT_t(실현 net active)는 별개 — 16/16 standalone FAIL 선례. Δskew 직교 입증돼도 PORT_t<2.95면 자본 graduation 불가(screen-tier 라우팅 가능).
5. 회전율: 차분신호는 빠르게 변동 → turnover 1,100% screening 한도 근접 위험, 15bps delta-cost 잠식. canonical turnover_annual 보고 필수.
6. 소형주 틸트: KR EW top20은 소형주 편향(measurement §6 cap-w 대비 ~+1.3t 낙관) — EW-uni 헤드라인 PORT_t를 cap-w authoritative와 구분 보고.
build_steps: 1. rawdata 로드: arrow open_dataset('.cache/rawdata.parquet'), filter Date∈[2004-07,2026-06](워밍업 위해 2005 전 6개월+), 유니버스 K200==1|KQ150==1, select Date/Ticker/Ret/Close/Vol/Size/BM_Ret. set_io_thread_count(2) (1은 HANG — measurement 06-18 교훈).
2. 종목별 시계열 정렬 후 data.table::frollapply 로 rolling 63d 표본왜도 s(t) 산출 (g1, na 윈도우 n_eff<40 → NA). PIT: window=[t-62..t], 우측정렬, no center.
3. s(t-63) = shift(s, 63) (data.table shift, type='lag' — 부호규약 data_table_shift_convention.md 준수, forward 금지). raw = s(t) - s(t-63).
4. 월말 sig_date 추출 (각 월 마지막 영업일 t). 해당 t의 raw 값만 보존 → 월간 패널 scores_raw(Date_eom, Ticker, raw).
5. 횡단면 winsorize [1%,99%] (월별) → z-score(월별) → signal. direction 양방향 score_plus=+signal, score_minus=-signal 생성.

6. forward returns_dt 구성: 각 sig_date t 에 대해 t+1월 실현 EW-편입 수익을 위해 익월 first-trading-day∼월말 Ret 누적 1M forward return Ret_1m (canonical_screen_bt가 요구하는 PIT-aligned forward). 손계산 cumprod 금지 — Return.portfolio/contract bridge 경유 또는 canonical 내부 routing 사용.
7. liq_dt: 20d 평균 거래대금 ADV=mean(Close*Vol, 20d, t-1까지) per (Date_eom,Ticker).
8. bench_dt: 월말 BM_Ret (rawdata BM_Ret 월간화 또는 .cache/benchmark.parquet).
9. canonical_screen_bt(scores_dt=score_plus, returns_dt, bench_dt, top_n=20, cost_bps=15, liq_dt, liq_min=2e8) → res_plus. 동일 score_minus → res_minus. PORT_t 부호 양수인 방향 채택(1개).

10. lookback_grid sweep: window∈{21,42,63,126} × top_n∈{15,20,25} × estimator∈{moment_g1,bowley} × winsorize∈{none,[1,99]} 각 셀 canonical_screen_bt 실측, portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 / net_sr / turnover_annual / information_ratio 표 산출. n_trials 기록(sweep → DSR 게이트).
11. 직교성: load_month_factors() 로 D43_Skewness/M22_Max_Return/M01_Mom_12_1/M13_VolAdj_Mom/D44_Kurtosis 월간 로드, 채택 셀 signal 과 월별 횡단면 Spearman corr 시계열 → mean+5/95% 분포. |corr|<목표 충족표.
12. essence_score.R 채점(oos_retention v2 3분할 중앙값, calmar, DSR if sweep). screening tier(hurdle_gate verdict$screening) + graduation tier 분리 보고. metric_type='canonical_screen' 라벨.
13. 정직 리포트: PORT_t(EW-uni) + cap-w 주의 + 직교 충족/미충족 + turnover + DSR(sweep) + 채택방향 mechanism 사후합리화 회피. PASS/의미있는실패만 L-code(modecode AS).
14. 모든 수치 metric_type 라벨, proxy 손계산 0건 확인 (measurement §1 self-check).
